tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ye shes rgya mtsho'i ngag 'don 'khrul med bzhugs/ /ye shes rgya mtsho ltos la go don long*/ /ye shes rgya mtsho'i dgongs don 'di bzung na/ /ye shes rgya mtsho'i don kun rtogs par 'gyur/ /

oṃ swā sti/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes rgya mtsho'i dgongs don zhes bya ba/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi sku ni kun 'gro mi zad gzhom du med/ /gsung gi skad kyang 'gro kun skad kyis lam rab ston/ /thugs ni bde ba dam pas gang ba'i ye shes nyid/ /'phrin las mtha' yas kun mkhyen ston pa de la 'dud/ /chos tshul rgya mtsho 'di la legs zhugs na/ /spobs pa rgya mtsho nges par skye 'gyur bas/ /yon tan rgya mtsho don gnyer shes ldan dag/ye shes rgya mtsho mchog la 'jug pa'i phyir/ /ngag 'don shin tu bzung bde ba/ /dam pa'i gsung gi yi ge dang*/ /bla ma'i man ngag dang bcas par/ /mdo tsam 'chad la spro ba skyes/ /de la sdom ni/ slob dpon slob ma yong brtag gsol gdab mchod/ /dus dang sa sogs brtags nas cho ga brtsams/ /sa dang gsol gdab bum pa thig skud tshon/ /rdo rje dril bu slob ma sta gon dang*/ /mal stan lhag par gnas rnams sta gon te/ /thig gdab tshon dgye sbyin sreg bum pa dgod/ /sngon du 'gro bas dkyil 'khor rab gnas mchod/ /dkyil 'khor chen por slob ma gzhug pa rnams/ /dbang gi sngon du 'gro ba'i cho ga yin/ /chu dang cod pan de bzhin dar dpyangs dang*/ /rdo rje dril bu brtul zhugs ming gi dbang*// rjes gnang dbang ste rnam bdun bsod nams rgyur/ /slob ma 'bring po rnams la mkhas pas sbyin// mchog gyur la ni bum pa gsang ba dang*/ /shes rab ye shes tshul khrims tshogs kyi rgyur/ /de nas bzhi pa don dam phyag rgya che/ /ye shes tshogs kyi don du sbyin par bya/ /'di dag gis ni dngos gzhi'i cho ga bsdus/ /dbul ba'i nges pa gshegs gsol rim pa dang*/ /bsnyen bkur rim pa dpa' bo'i ston mo yi/ /nges pa dag ste rjes kyi cho ga'o/ /kun spangs la ni mtha' dag tshig gis sbyin/ /srid gsum ma lus snying rje'i dbang gis bsdus/ /slob dpon la ni bdag po bdag po che/

/zhes pa'o// de la dang po slob dpon dang slob ma yongs su brtag pa ni/ dbang gi cho ga chen mo ye shes rgya mtshor shes par bya la/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ slob mar 'gyur ba des/ maṇḍal sngon du 'gro bas/ bcom ldan 'das gang du mtshams med pa lnga byed pa po rnams kyang*/ skye ba 'di nyid la sangs rgyas thob par lung ston zhing*/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bde ba mchog tu mi 'gyur bas yang dag par bsdus pa'i phyag rgya chen po thob par lung ston pa/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa dang*/ dbang bskur bas mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes bla ma la lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyis kyang khas blangs la/ 'og tu 'chad pa ltar so shing byin la/ mgo bor ū yig sogs rigs drug gi sa bon bkod/ yid kyis bsrung ba bya/ sngags kyi che ba brjod la spro ba bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang*/ gtor ma dang*/ rnal 'byor ma mchod pa rnams kyang nges par bya ste/ de ltar na gsol ba gdab cing mchod pa 'di ni/ gzhan du slob ma rjes bzung du grags pa nyid do/ /de'i rjes su dus nges pa dang*/ sa yongs su brtag pa yang dbang chog chen por shes par bya'o/ /'di man chad kyi don rnams bsdu na/ sa'i cho ga dang*/ lhag par gnas pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang*/ dbang gi bya ba dang*/ rjes kyi bya ba'o/ /dang po ni bris sku la sogs pa dgram/ mchod pa rnams lag len bzhin du bshams/ slob dpon shar du mngon par phyogs pa'i mdun du rdo rje dril bu nang mchod rnams nges par bsham zhing*/ cang te'u dang*/ gzhan yang rol lo'i bye brag rnams kyang tshogs par byas/ 'dir rgyud sde gzhan nas gsungs pa'i sngon 'gro gtor ma ni mtha' gcig tu mi dgos kyang*/ lag len la mdzad cing phan yon lhag po las skyon du 'gyur ba med par mngon/ yul bdag grong bdag gi gtor chog nyid rgyud 'di'i lugs kyi sngon 'gro gtor ma yin la/

de yang gnyis kar byed pa rang lugs yin no/ /bdag bskyed kyi sngon 'gro'i skabs ma byas kyang chog mod/ byas na legs pas sngon 'gro gtor ma lcog zlum gcig zlum gtor nyis sgrigs tshar gnyis dang*/ bsrung 'khor gyi mthar bsrung ma drug cu la 'bul rgyu'i gtor ma bdun nam/ gcig sa lha'i gcig gzhan zlum gtor bzang po gnyis rnams dang*/ gzhan yang mchod pa mang po dang bcas pa rnams grabs su tshud par byas nas/ thog mar nang mchod la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ de nas tshogs pa yod na sngon 'gro gtor ma'i zhu 'bul bya/ tshogs pa med na mi dgos/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ oṃ oṃ badzra tsand+ra sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥbadzra sūrya sogs dang*/ oṃ hūṃ badzra a na la sogs dang*/ oṃ hoḥsarba dharma sogs sngags tshan bzhis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ phaiṃ badzra a ralli ho/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ badzra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya st+waṃ/ dṛ shya ho/ oṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ <zo cig zo cig3gt; sarba yakṣa rākṣa sa/ <gnod sbyin srin po > bhū ta <'byung po > pre ta <yi dwags > pi shā tse/ <sha za > ud man dā < smyo byed > a pa smā ra/ < brjed byed > ḍā ka ḍā ki ni dā ya/ <mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro ma rnams la ster ba'i > i daṃ ba liṃ/ <gtor ma 'di > gri hnan tu/ <bzung du gsol/> sa ma ya rakṣantu/ <dam tshig bsrung ba kyis shig3gt; ma ma sarba siddhiṃ me pra yatstshantu/ <bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsal tu gsol/> ya the baṃ ya the ṣtaṃ/ <ji ltar 'dod pa de ltar > bhu dzā thā/ <bza' ba > dzi ghra tha/ <myang ba > pi pā tha/ <btung ba > ma ti kra ma tha/ <rim pa las ma 'das par > ma ma sarba karta ya/ <bdag gi dgos pa thams cad > sad su khaṃ bi shuddha/ <bde ba dam pa rnam par dag pa'i > sa hā yi ka <grogs mdzod > bha wantu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/

<mdzod du gsol/> oṃ badzra gandhaṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ badzra puṣpaṃ/ badzra dhū paṃ/ badzra dī paṃ/ badzra nai wi tyaṃ/ badzra akṣa taṃ/ badzra lā syaṃ/ badzra hā syaṃ/ badzra wā tyaṃ/ badzra nṛ tyaṃ/ badzra gī taṃ/ oṃ badzra kā maṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ / rang bzhin gyi ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ / rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog rdo rje nam mkha' 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ / padma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung*/ /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ / klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang*/ /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs/ /ma lus ji snyed mchis pa rnams/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ / nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/

/las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi stongs grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*/ /bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /gang dag dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba rnams mchod pa dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa'i bya ba la bar chad thams cad mi 'byung ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig nag po'i phyogs la dga' ba dang*/ gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig ces pa'i mthar bdud sreg pa'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad la/ tshams rngams dang rol mo'i sgra drag po bya/ rdo rje'i rwa gur sa gzhi la sogs pa dang*/ me'i gur sogs yid kyis bsams te/ bgegs dang mtshams bcad pa'o/ /de nas gnas yo byin rlabs kyi zhu 'bul bya/ rdo rje'i rtse mos nang mchod gtor la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hra phaṭa/ <rdo rje bzhi'i sa bon > oṃ swa bhā wa <rang bzhin > shuddhāḥ <dag pa rnams > sarba dharmāḥ <chos rnams thams cad > swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ <rang bzhin dag pa'i bdag go/> stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bhruṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang*/ gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ shel gyi snod sor bcu gnyis pa rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥrnams las byung ba'i chu dang*/ mchod yon dang*/ dri dang*/ me tog dang*/ bdug pa dang*/ snang gsal dang*/ zhal zas dam pa dag dang*/ rnam pa mang po'i 'bras bu ma nyams pa dang*/ gos dang*/ rgyan dang*/ ba dan dang*/ bla bre la sogs pa dang*/ glu dang*/ gar dang*/ me long dang*/

dril bu la sogs pa sil snyan gyi tshogs du ma dag dang*/ ind+ra nī la la sogs pa rnam pa mang po'i rin po che dang*/ nang gi dam tshig rnams dang*/ dam tshigs rnam pa bzhi'i rdzas la sogs pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu dpag tu med cing dri ma dang bral bar gyur/ oṃ badzra gandhaṃ <rdo rje dri > swāhā/ badzra puṣpaṃ/ <rdo rje me tog > badzra dhū paṃ/ <rdo rje bdug pa > badzra dī paṃ/ <rdo rje sgron me > badzra nai wi tyaṃ/ <rdo rje zhal zas > badzra akṣa taṃ/ <rdo rje 'bras bu > badzra lā syaṃ/ <rdo rje sgeg mo > badzra hā syaṃ/ <rdo rje bzhad ma > badzra bā tyaṃ/ <rdo rje sil snyan > badzra nṛ tyaṃ/ <rdo rje gar ma > badzra gī tyaṃ/ <rdo rje glu ma > badzra kā maṃ <rdo rje 'dod ma > swāhā/ rol chen dang bcas te/ oṃ hoḥ <gtso mo'i sa bon > badzra ghaṇḍe <rdo rje dril bu > sarba dharma ai ka <chos thams cad gcig pa > pradzñā dhā ni swa bhā we/ <shes rab kyi rang bzhin > sarba ā kā re/ <rnam pa thams cad pa > sarba dharma pra bo dha ni/ <chos thams cad rab tu sad par byed pa > sarba dharman niḥ <chos thams cad > swa bhā we na/ <rang bzhin med pa > pra po dha ya pra po dha ya swāhā/ <rab tu rtogs par mdzod mdzod/> zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas zhu 'bul ni/ phyag gsum btsal te maṇḍal bkod/ phyag gsum btsal te me tog bkram/ phyag gsum btsal te zhu 'bul bya/ de yang*/ kun bzang rnam 'phrul mchod pa'i sprin phung gis/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams mchod pa dang*/ /yon bdag bgegs zhi tshogs gnyis bsag bya'i phyir/ /gnyis med ting 'dzin dag la gnas par mdzod/ / ces so/ /phyag gsum btsal te me tog bsdu/ phyag gsum btsal te maṇḍal 'bul/ oṃ badzra bhū mi āḥhūṃ/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du/ oṃ badzra re khe āḥhūṃ/ phyi lcags ri mu khyud kyis bskor ba'i dbus su/

hūṃ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho dzambu gling*/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nub ba glang spyod/ sgra gcan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ dus me/ dbus su lha dang m-i'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/ tshogs kyi slob dpon zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gu ru i daṃ ratna maṇḍa la kaṃ nīryā ta yā mi/ de nas tshogs kyi rdo rje slob dpon des kyang maṇḍa la kha gsos te gsol ba gdab bo/ /de rjes phyag gsum btsal te ci bder 'khod/ de ltar na zhu 'bul phyag dang bcas pa 'di rnams tshogs pa yod na bya la/ tshogs pa med na mi dgos shing*/ tshogs pa yod kyang 'di dag bor bas chog chad pa'i nyes par 'gyur ba ni ma yin no/ /de rjes skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bzlas pa'i bar sgrub thabs su ji skad bshad pa'i mngon rtogs rdzogs par bsgom pa las/ rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mchod bstod bsdus pa byas pa'i mthar/ gtsug tor du rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa nas/ rab gtum ma rnams gshegs su gsol/ zhes bsdus la/ slar yang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa ti badzra satwa ā haṃ dur dān ta da ma ka huṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes nga rgyal bzung*/ yul bdag grong bdag gi gtor ma cha gnyis pa de chu chang nang mchod kyis sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ oṃ oṃ sogs sngags tshan bzhis byin gyis brlabs/ de nas oṃ āḥhūṃ yul gyi bdag po sa pa ri wā ra sogs lan gsum dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ grong gi bdag po sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ dril bu 'khrol bzhin du/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan yang rung*/ /dkyil 'khor don du sa 'di ni/ /bdag zhu khyed kyis stsal du gsol/ /sa'i phyogs 'dir bdag rdo rje ༵༵ chgaie mo <slob dpon ming 'di >

zhes bgyi bas/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs par 'tshal na/ khyed rnams kyis sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la stsal te/ ji srid dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du gnas gzhan du gshegs shing*/ bdag cag slob mar bcas pa la phan pa dang*/ zhi ba'i sems dang ldan par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gtor ma phyir btang zhing rol mo'i sgra bya'o/ /de nas bdud tshogs sreg pa ni/ rang nyid dus kyi 'khor lo'i skur gsal ba'i dpral par zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ dkar po las rdo rje rtse mo bcu bdun pa dang*/ zhes pa nas/ bhasmi ku ru ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa kyi bar te/ shugs drag pos me'i sngags de lan mang du bzla bar bya'o/ /de nas sa'i lha mo la gnang ba zhu ba ni/ mdun du dri bzang po'i maṇḍal la me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ sa lha'i mchod gtor bshams/ rang gi snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ laṃ las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ sa'i lha mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ser mo/ g.yas zhal dkar zhing g.yon zhal nag pa/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis 'khor lo/ dbyug pa/ khro bo'i rdo rje/ g.yon pa gsum gyis dung*/ rdo rje'i lcags sgrogasgra dang bcas pa'i dril bu 'dzin zhing*/ padma'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa/ na bza' ser po can/ rin po che'i rgyan ser pos brgyan pa'i dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ lte bar hoḥ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ sa'i lha mo ye shes pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig sems dpa' dang ro gcig tu gyur/ oṃ lāṃ āḥhūṃ/ ba sundha ri sarba buddha dza na ni/ sarba satwa u pa kā ri ṇi/ badzra satwā ādzñā pa ya ti/ shi ghraṃ/ ā gatstsha ā gatstsha/ i daṃ/ gandhaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ nai we tyaṃ/ pha la akṣa taṃ/ da dā mi ta wa twa me kha/ gṛ hṇa gṛ hṇa/ maṇḍa la ar thaṃ/ ma ma sthā naṃ da da/

sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis byon te tshom bu'i steng du 'khod pa la/ rang gi snying gar bzhugs pa'i sa'i lha mo yang thim/ ba sun dha ri sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ arghaṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ gandhaṃ= puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ nai we tyaṃ/ pha la akṣa taṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ

zhes pa rnams kyis mchod/ gtor ma sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ba sun dha ri pa ri wā re bhyaḥ i daṃ ba liṃ sogs bsrung ma drug cu'i gtor sngags dang 'dra bas phul nas/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ rgyal bas lha yi bdag po dang bcas bdud ni bcom pa dag la lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /de phyir khyod ni mchod par bya yis lha mchog gis btung ba bzhes shig bzhes shig bdag gi mchod yon no/ /ji ltar rgyal bas byang chub slad du bdud kyi sde ni stobs ldan dag kyang rab tu bcom gyur pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis kyang ni slob ma rnams la dbang bskur slad du bdud rnams nyams pa dag tu bya/ /khyod dpang du gyur pas so/ /sarba satwā nāṃ/ shāntiṃ puṣtiṃ/ kṛ twā shu bha/ tsitte na/ i daṃ sthā naṃ/ tyakt+wa a pa ra sthā naṃ/ gatstsha gatstsha swāhā/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar bsdu 'o/ /yungs kar dang dri bzang gi chu dang*/ shing thal rnams bsres pa dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la gtor zhing*/ oṃ āḥbigha nān ta krita hūṃ/ ces lan nyer gcig tsam brjod/ oṃ bhu khaṃ nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur/ hūṃ laṃ hūṃ rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ me di ni badzri bha wa badzra bandha hūṃ/ oṃ ha na ha na badzra kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ sho dha ya sho dha ya rakṣa rakṣa huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing lag pa sa la reg ste byin gyis brlabs/ 'di ni da ltar lag len byed pa la/ khang bzang dang*/ gtsug lag khang dang*/ dkyil 'khor khang pa rnying par dkyil 'khor 'dri ba'i dbang du byas te/ sa gzhi brko sbyangs mi dgos pa'i lugs yin la/ gzhan du na skabs 'dir lto 'phye brtag pa dang*/ sa brko ba dang*/ sel dbyung ba dang*/ gter gzhug pa rnams kyang dgos te/ dbang chog chen por shes par bya'o/ khang bzang la sogs par yang sa'i stegs bu byed na gter gzhug pa sogs pa 'ga' zhig dgos so/

/de nas bsrung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ slob dpon chas gos kyis klubs/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir 'dug ste/ dang por haṃ las byung ba'i nam mkha'i rang bzhin zhes pa nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rakṣā tsakra swa bhā ba ātma ko3haṃ/ ces pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin no/ /de nas phur gdab ni/ phur bu bcu mchod pa dang bcas pa bshams/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ lan bcu gnyis kyis mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ phur bu rnams stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ bcu las byung ba'i khro bo'i rgyal po gdong drug 'jigs pa khams drug rnam par dag pa rigs drug gi bdag nyid can/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog sngon po/ g.yas gnyis nag po dang dmar ba/ g.yon gnyis dkar po dang ser ba/ steng zhal ljang khu/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje/ gri gug dgra st+wa/ g.yon pa gsum gyis rdo rje dril bu/ thod pa/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs drug pa/ khro bo'i rgyan dang cha byad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ thams cad kyi dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ lte bar hoḥ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' khro bo badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ badzra kī li kī li ya sarba bighan banda hūṃ phaṭa/ tshar bcu brjod/ gandhaṃ sogs mchod pa bcu gnyis phul/ phur bu'i khro bo rnams lte ba man chad mdung gi rtse mo lta bu phur bu'i dbyibs can 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrug pa/ sa gsum gyi bdud dang bgegs thams cad 'joms pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyis phur bu phyogs bcur rim bzhin 'debs pa las/ tshigs bcad rnams kyi skabs/ slob dpon gyis phur bu lag tu thogs/ tshigs bcad de yang dbyangs dang bcas pas byed/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ kṣaḥ nas/ kī la ya huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa kyi bar sngags dang pos phur bu bsgril zhing phyogs so sor phur gdan la 'debs/

oṃ ll̥̄ badzra nas/ kṣl̥ṃ kṣl̥̄ṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa kyi bar sngags phyi ma 'don dus/ phur bu'i steng du tho ba'am tho ba'i phyag rgyas 'debs tshul du byed/ oṃ haṃ sogs phur bu bsrung ba'i khro bo'i sngags lan gsum brjod dus/ phur bu'i khro bo bgegs la btab cing*/ phur pa nyid kyang bsrung ba dang*/ gzhan yang phyogs kyi bgegs bsrung ba'i don du/ bsrung 'khor gyi khro bo las khro bo gnyis pa zhig chad de/ phur bu'i rgyab tu bzhugs par mos/ don de bzhin yid la bzhag nas/ shar gyi shar tu phur bu btab pa ni/ 'khor los sgyur rgyal khro bo che/ /nyi zla tshangs sogs 'khor dang bcas/ /gdug pa can rnams gzhom pa'i phyir/ /phur bus thob cig kī la ya// oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ kṣaḥhūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa badzra kī la/ kā ya wāka tsitta dzñā na a dhi pa ti ṣaḍa mu kha/ ṣaḍa bhu dza/ ṣaḍa tsa ra ṇa/ sarba bighna bi nā ya ka ā di duṣtā nāṃ/ kā ya wāka tsitta dzñā nā ni/ kī la ya kī la ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ de bzhin du/ oṃ ll̥̄+-iḥbadzra mud ga ra/ mā ra ā dī nāṃ/ si ra si kanṭhe hrī da ye nā bhau gu hye/ ante badzra kī la kān/ ā ko ṭa ya/ ā ko ṭa ya/ kṣaṃ kṣāṃ kṣiṃ kṣīṃ kṣuṃ kṣūṃ kṣl̥ṃ kṣl̥̄ṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ haṃ badzra kro dha rā dza mahā uṣṇī ṣa ur dha di shi rakṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ de bzhin du gzhan rnams la yang sbyar te/ shar du/ bgegs mthar byed pa khro bo che/ /dbang po nyed dbang 'khor dang bcas/ /gdug pa can= /phur bus thob= /oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ kṣaḥ= oṃ ll̥̄ badzra= oṃ yaṃ badzra kro dha rā dza a ti bā la sarba bighna anta ka pūrba di shi rakṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ lhor/ shes rab mthar byed khro bo che/ /gshin rje ma mo 'khor dang bcas/ /gdug pa= /phur bus= /oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ kṣaḥ= oṃ ll̥̄ badzra= oṃ raṃ badzra kro dha rā dza dzaṃ bha ka duṣta pradzñā anta ka dakṣi ṇa di shi rakṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/

byang du/ padma mthar byed khro bo che/ /gnod sbyin nor lha 'khor dang bcas// gdub pa= /phur bur= /oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ kṣaḥ= oṃ ll̥̄ badzra= oṃ waṃ badzra kro dha rā dza mā nā ka bi rā ka padma anta ka utta ra di shi rakṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ nub tu/ gshin rje mthar byed khro bo che/ /chu bdag klu yi 'khor dang bcas/ gdug pa= /phur bus=/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ kṣaḥ= oṃ ll̥̄ badzra= oṃ laṃ badzra kro dha rā dza staṃ bha ka ya ma anta ka paṣtsi ma di shi rakṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ nub byang du/ stobs chen rgyal po khro bo che// rlung lha rig 'dzin 'khor dang bcas/ /gdug pa= /phur bus= /oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ kṣaḥ= oṃ ll̥̄ badzra = oṃ lāḥbadzra kro dha rā dza mahā bā la bā ya byāṃ di shi rakṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ byang shar du/ mi g.yo rgyal po khro bo che/ /dbang ldan 'byung po 'khor dang bcas/ gdug pa= /phur bus= /oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ kṣaḥ= oṃ ll̥̄ badzra= oṃ wāḥbadzra kro dha rā dza a tsa la ī shan di shi rakṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ lho nub tu/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po khro bo che/ /bden bral srin po 'khor dang bcas/ /gdug pa= /phur bus= / oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ kṣaḥ= oṃ ll̥̄ badzra= oṃ rāḥbadzra kro dha rā dza ṭakki ne ṛ tyāṃ di shi rakṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ shar lhor/ dbyug sngon rgyal po khro bo che/ /me lha drang srong 'khor dang bcas/ /gdug pa= /phur bas= /oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ kṣaḥ= oṃ ll̥̄ badzra= oṃ yāḥbadzra kro dha rā dza nī la daṇḍā agne yyāṃ di shi rakṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ 'og tu/ gnod mdzes rgyal po khro bo che/ /sa lha lha min 'khor dang bcas/ gdug pa can rnams gzhom pa'i phyir/ /phur bus thob cig kī la ya/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ kṣaḥ= oṃ ll̥̄ badzra= oṃ hāḥbadzra kro dha rā dza sum bha a dho di shi rakṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ rdo rje'i tho bas brdungs te bgegs kyi tshogs rnams bde ba chen por ro gcig pa'i de bzhin nyid rnam par dag par gyur/

de nas phur bu bcu bsrung ba'i khro bo bcu dang bcas pa rnams la mchod pa'i don du/ gtor ma gcig mchod pa dang bcas pa bshams/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs sngags tshan bzhis byin gyis brlabs/ mchod pa rnams kyang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ.uṣṇī ṣa sogs bsung ma drug cu'i skabs ltar khro bo bcu la phul/ oṃ badzra gandhaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ ha hā yi yī wu wū ll̥ll̥̄ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes nang mchod phul/ dpal ldan gtsug tor sogs/ shlau ka gcig gis bstod/ ji srid dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs mtha' dag bsrung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ gzhom pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ / de dag ni phur gdab kyi bya ba'o/ /de nas ji srid cho ga ma grol gyi bar nyin re bzhin dus gsum du phur bu rnams la yungs kar gyis gtor/ gu gul gyis bdug dri bzang gi chus bsangs gtor bya/ 'grub na sgos kyi gtor ma re yang 'bul zhing*/ gal te ma lcogs na bsrung 'khor dang dkyil 'khor la gtor ma 'bul ba'i skabs/ phur bu'i lha la dmigs nas gsol ba 'debs pa la'ang nan tan du bya'o/ /mdor bsdus pa'i tshe stangs stabs kyis sa bzung ba med kyang chog la/ cung zad spro na lugs 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa ni/ oṃ hūṃ kro dha in dro sogs kyis nga rgyal bzung la/ rkang mthil gnyis su hūṃ hūṃ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas reg rdo rje'i rkang stabs kyis dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bcags nas/ gzhi bca' sngon du 'gro ba'i g.yas brkyang g.yon brkyang mnyam pa'i stabs rnams bya'o/ / yaṃ yāḥ dang ral gri'i phyag rgya dang*/ shar du 'chag ste zlum po'i stabs so/ / raṃ rāḥ dang rin po che'i phyag rgya dang*/ lhor 'chag ste rol pa'i stabs so/ / laṃ lāḥ dang 'khor lo'i phyag rgya dang*/ nub tu 'chag ste sa ka'i stabs so// baṃ bāḥ dang padma'i phyag rgya dang*/

byang du 'chag ste tāṇḍa pa'i stabs kyis so/ /nub tu rdo rje'i skyil krung dang*/ byang du padma'i skyil krung kyang bshad de/ 'di tsam zhig rgyud 'grel las 'byung ngo*/ /phreng ba sogs gzhan nas kha bskang ba'i gar gyi cho ga rgyas pa ni 'dir ma bshad do/ /shes par 'dod na kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa'i gar dpe dang*/ lag len mthong ba brgyud pa las shes par bya'o// £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ gnyis pa ni/ £© slar yang dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la mchod pa'i don du mchod pa bshams/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ lan bcu gnyis kyis byin gyis brlabs/ badzra gandhaṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ nas/ badzra kā maṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ zhes pas dam tshig gi sa gzhi la mchod/ sngar sa'i lha mo gshegs su gsol ba spyan drangs te sa la thim par mos te/ oṃ āḥlaṃ hūṃ sarba buddha dza na ni zhes pa nas/ sthā naṃ dang zhes pa'i bar dang*/ sa'i lha mo sa gzhi la thim/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ don dam ye shes kyi rang bzhin rdo rje'i sa gzhi spyan drangs te dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi dang ro gcig tu gyur/ oṃ āḥlāṃ hūṃ/ badzra bhū mi tiṣṭha ma tsa la huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ badzra dha ra ādzñā pa ya ti swāhā/ zhes lan mang du brjod/ yang mchod pa kha gsos te/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ nas/ kā maṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ zhes pas sa gzhi la mchod de/ sa lhag par gnas pa'o/ /slar yang bsrung 'khor bzhin bsrung ma drug cu'i gtor ma 'bul te/ 'byung po'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol gyi bar bya/ bsod nams 'di yis 'gro rnams sogs smon lam dang bkra shis gang 'grub cig bya'o/ /nyi ma dang po'i bya ba'o/ /de nas mchod pas sangs sbyangs byin rlabs nas bzung*/ da ma ka huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ kyis nga rgyal bzung ba'i bar/ gong nyi ma dang po'i skabs dang 'dra/ de nas rgyud sde gzhan gyi cho ga'i sa lha lhag gnas mi dgos te/ gong du rdo rje'i sa gzhi bkug ste sa gzhi byin gyis brlob pa de nyid 'dir rang lugs kyi sa lha lhag gnas rmad du byung ba yin pas so/

/des na/ gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ rdzas lnga lhag gnas dang*/ slob ma lhag gnas dang*/ mal stan lhag gnas rnams so/ /dang po ni dkyil 'khor lhag gnas kyi don yin te/ dkyil 'khor kyi sa gzhir dri bzang gis byugs/ spyi 'gro dang mthun pa'i dgos pa yod pas lhag gnas mi 'chol ba'i phyir/ thig chen brgyad dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi rtsa thig dang*/ mda' yab kyi thig dang*/ bde chen 'khor lo dang*/ gtso bo'i padma'i thig rnams skam thig tsam btab la/ lha so so'i gnas su me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa'i srol yod pa ltar bya/ thig dang tshom bu dgod pa 'di nges par dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /gzhan yang me tog sil ma bcal du bkram/ mtha' skor du mchod pa dang gtor ma lag len bzhin bshams/ mdun bskyed/ oṃ āḥhuṃ hraḥphaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung 'byung ba rim brtsegs lhun po dang bcas pa'i steng du*/ thugs gsung sku'i dkyil 'khor rnams mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ phyogs kun tu ye shes kyi 'od zer mtha' yas pa kun tu 'phro ba/ dbang po'i gzhu dang*/ me long gi gzugs brnyan dang*/ pra phab brgyad dang mtshungs par snang la rang bzhin med pa/ rang gi sems nyid kyi so sor snang ba/ so sor rang gis rig pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul/ gzhom du med cing rdul phra rab kyi chos las 'das pa/ dwangs shing sgrib pa med la phyi nang kun tu 'od gsal ba/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing*/ rgyan gyi rnam pa mchog tu bkra ba du mas mdzes pa/ dbus su sna tshogs padma'i lte ba la/ zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la sogs pa/ gnas thams cad du lha'i gdan thams cad kyis mdzes pa'o/ /gdan rnams kyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo yab yum/ nus ma bcu/ de bzhin gshegs pa yab yum bcu/ sems dpa' yab yum bcu gnyis/ khro bo khro mo brgyad/

<rdo rje gnod sbyin rnams la mchod do//> oṃ bā ru ṇyai maḥ <chu lha mo la mchod do//> oṃ bā ya bai na maḥ <rlung lha mo mchod do//> oṃ yā mi n+yai na maḥ <gshin rje mo la mchod do//> oṃ yakṣi ṇyai na maḥ <gnod sbyin mo la mchod do//> oṃ mahā ba lā ya na maḥ <stobs po che la mchod do//> oṃ a tsa lā ya na maḥ <mi g.yo ba la mchod do//> oṃ ṭakki rā dzā ya na maḥ <'dod pa'i rgyal po la mchod do//> oṃ nī la danḍā ya na maḥ <dbyug pa sngon po la mchod do//> oṃ sum bhā rā dzā ya na maḥ <gnod mdzes rgyal po la mchod do//> oṃ rau dra akṣe na maḥ <drag spyan ma la mchod do//> oṃ badzra shrīṃ kha lā yai na maḥ <rdo rje lcags sgrog ma la mchod do//> oṃ tsin dā yai na maḥ <skul byed ma la mchod do//> oṃ bhṛ ku ṭyai na maḥ <khro gnyer can ma la mchod do//> oṃ mā rī tsyai na maḥ <'od zer can ma la mchod do//> oṃ pra tyai ka mā sa bhe de na <so so re re zla ba'i dbye bas > ṣiṣṭhi utta ra tri

oṃ badzra pṛ haspa ta ye na maḥ <rdo rje phur bu la mchod do//> oṃ badzra shu krā ya na maḥ <rdo rje pa sangs la mchod do//> oṃ badzra sha naiṣtsa rā ya na maḥ <rdo rje spen pa la mchod do//> oṃ badzra ke ta be na maḥ <rdo rje mjug ring la mchod do//> oṃ badzra rā ha be na maḥ <rdo rje sgra gcan la mchod do//> oṃ badzra kā lāgna yai na maḥ <rdo rje dus me la mchod do//> oṃ badzra dhru be na maḥ <rdo rje brtan pa la mchod do//> oṃ badzra a gast+ya ya na maḥ <rdo rje ri byi la mchod do//> oṃ sarba nakṣa tre bhyo na maḥ <rgyu skar rnams thams cad la mchod do//> oṃ dwā da sha rā si bhyo na maḥ <bcu gnyis kyi khyim rnams la mchod do//> oṃ ṣo ṭa sha ka lā bhyo na maḥ <bcu drug gi cha rnams la mchod do//> oṃ da sha dika pā le bhyo na maḥ <bcu gnyis kyi phyogs skyong rnams la mchod do//> oṃ badzra nandi ke shwa rā ya na maḥ <rdo rje dga' byed dbang phyug la mchod do//> oṃ badzra mahā kā lā ya na maḥ <rdo rje nag po chen po la mchod do//> oṃ badzra ghaṇḍā karṇā ya na maḥ <rdo rje dril bu'i rna ba can la mchod do//> oṃ badzra bhṛṃ gi ṇe na maḥ <rdo rje 'bring gi ṇe la mchod do//> oṃ sarba kṣe tra pā le bhyo na maḥ <zhing skyong rnams thams cad la mchod do//> oṃ sarba dū tī bhyo na maḥ <pho nya mo rnams thams cad la mchod do//> oṃ hā ri tyai bhyo na maḥ <'phrog ma rnams la mchod do//> oṃ sarba siddhi bhyo na maḥ <grub pa rnams thams cad la mchod do//> <'jig rten pa rnams la'o//> oṃ dharma tsakrā ya na maḥ <chos kyi 'khor lo la mchod do//> oṃ bha dra gha ḍā ya na maḥ <bum pa bzang po la mchod do//> oṃ badzra dun du bhyai na maḥ <rdo rje rnga bo che la mchod do//> oṃ bo dhi prikṣā ya na maḥ <byang chub kyi shing la mchod do//> <sku'i rta babs kyi mtshan ma la'o//>

oṃ gu ru buddha bo dhi satwe bhyo na mo na maḥ <bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la mchod cing phyag 'tshal lo//> gzhan yang rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad la mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bka' sdod chos skyong bsrung ma thams cad la mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ yul bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad la mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad la 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud tshim nas/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar gyur cig / de nas bstod pa ni/ gang la thog mtha' dbus med gnas dang 'chi dang srid pa dang ni sgra dang dri dang ro dag dang*/ /reg bya gzugs dang sems med rang bzhin dang ni skyes bu med cing 'ching dang grol dang byed po med/ /sa bon dang ni gsal bar dus med mtha' dag srid pa'-i sdug bsngal bde ba nyid kyi rang bzhin med/ /mya ngan 'das pa mtshan ma med cing byed pa rnams bral yon tan med pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus dang sna tshogs la sogs rdo rje dang ni skyes bu dpe med kun 'gro spros pa med pa ste/ /ther zug tu gnas snyan dang shangs dang zhal dang spyan dang dbu dang phyag dang zhabs ni thams cad pa/ /'byung po'i mtha' ste 'byung po'i mgon po mchog gi srid pa gsum 'dzin rgyu rnams dag gis rgyur gyur pa/ /rig pa la sogs rnal 'byor dag gis rtogs bya mchog bde'i go 'phang dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal/ /spros byed nus ma'i gzugs gzhan glog gi me dang mtshungs shing nyi ma bcu gnyis dag gi gzi brjid can/ /ye shes rdo rje'i snang ba mchog gi go 'phang bgrod byed rnam par bcad pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkar po 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po ri bong 'dzin pa las 'dzag 'jig rten spyi bor yang dag gnas/

/bdud rtsi 'chi ba sel zhing srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms par byed pa thig le'i gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems tsam sngags kyi ngo bo lha yis yongs su skor ba sdug bsngal dang ni bde ba'i rang bzhin te/ /dam pa rnams la zhi ba'i gzugs ni rang gis byas pa'i nyams myong mi zad rnams la mi zad pa/ /gang gis las gang rab byas rang gi sems la cho ga bzhin du de'i 'bras bu de bskyed pa/ /'jig rten dbang po sna tshogs gzugs can srid gsum bskyed mdzad rdo rje sems dpa' la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /gcig dang du ma dag kyang gcig cing mnyam dang mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab dang*/ /steng 'og kun nas dkar ljang sna tshogs kha dog chen po gcig gi gzugs te thung ngu ring po dang*/ /shin tu ring po yon tan med ces yon tan dang bcas bud med skyes pa'am skyes pa bud med min/ /gang zhig kun kyi rten gcig bha ga bzang mo mchog gi bha ga khyod la 'dud de khyod la 'dud/ / de nas spos dang bcas pa'i rdor dril 'dzin pas/ sems can rnams ni thar pa'i slad du chgai <slob dpon > bdag kyang gtso bo'i dkyil 'khor dag ni bzhengs par bgyid/ /gang dag phyogs rnams kun na sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' nyes pa rnams bral btsun mo dang bcas pa/ /de dag rnams kyi mchog gi thugs rjes dkyil 'khor du ni dbang bskur <bsgrub cing mchod pa'i > slad du bdag la bskyab tu gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gyis gsol gdab/ de nas spro na da lta lag len la byed pa ltar/ rgyud sde gzhan gyi cho gas snyan gsan dbab pa yang bya ste/ bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo mchog/rig pa'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud/ /slob ma rnams la brtse phyir dang*/ khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /dkyil 'khor 'bri bar bdag 'tshal lo/ /de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la/ /bka' drin gnang bar mdzad par rigs/

/sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang*/ gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha/ /lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang*/ /'byung po byang chub bstan gnas dang*/ /sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /gang su rdo rje'i spyan mnga' rnams/ /bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ༵ni rdo rje ༵ chgai <'dzin pa > ༵can/ /dus 'khor 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /ji ltar nus pa'i nyer sbyor ba/ /'gro ba spyad phyir bri bar bya/ /de phyir bdag dang slob ma ni/ /rjes su brtse bas nyer bzung ste/ / dkyil 'khor dang bcas thams cad ni/ /nye bar byon par mdzad pa'i rigs/ / zhes lan gsum/ 'on kyang 'di cho ga gzhan gyi lugs yin pa'i phyir nges par dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /slar yang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs dang*/ bsrung ma drug cu dang*/ mgon po lcam dral sogs sgos kyi chos skyong rnams dang*/ mkha' 'gro spyi dang*/ yul bdag grong bdag gi gtor ma rnams gtor chog bzhin phul la/ rjes chog ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa/ ces pa nas/ dpag tu med cing dri ma dang bral bar gyur/ badzra gandhaṃ swāhā nas/ kā maṃ swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ trai dhā tu kai shwa ra kā la tsakra arghaṃ pra tītstsha zhes pa nas/ oṃ shrī kā la tsakra sa pa ri bā re bhyaḥkā maṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ zhes pa'i bar mchod pa bcu gnyis dang*/ nang mchod ni/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ shrī kā la tsakra sa pa ri bā re bhyaḥ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bstod pa ni/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ ces sogs 'dud nyi shu 'don/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams bdag cag la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ nus mthu'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/

spyir gyi phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba dang*/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs shing*/ zhal bzhugs pa rnams sku khams bzang ba dang*/ khyad par du yang bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor ba dang bcas pas thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag nas/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ yig brgya tshar gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ sogs/ oṃ badzra muḥ bsod nams 'di yis 'gro rnams sogs smon lam dang bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad gang 'os byas la/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bar bsdu ba'o/ /de nas bum pa la sogs pa rdzas lnga lhag gnas ni/ bum pa rnams rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te stegs bu bum gdan dang bcas pa la/ dbus kyi shar du rgyal ba dang*/ nub tu rnam rgyal bum pa bzhag phyogs mtshams brgyad du bum pa brgyad bkod/ rgyal ba'i steng du rnam rgyal chen po'i dung chos bzhag mtshan ma rang chas su med na 'dri ba'am 'dogs/ bum rdzas rnams bcug bshad tshod med kyang lag len la gzungs thag kyang 'dogs kyin snang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pas ngang las/ haṃ hāṃ hiṃ hīṃ huṃ hūṃ hl̥ṃ hl̥̄ṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su khu ba dang rdul 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang*/ shar dang mer rkang 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang*/ lho dang bden bral du khrag 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang*/ byang dang dbang ldan du gci ba 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang*/ nub dang rlung du bshang ba 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis te/ bdud rtsi'i bum pa dkar po padma la gnas shing padmas kha brgyan pa rnams su gyur/ rang gi snying gar zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las/ dus kyi 'khor lo sna tshogs yum dang bcas par gsal ba'i yab kyi thugs kar zla ba dang*/

yum gyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor te/ de dag kha sbyar ba las rdo rje lcags kyu dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba spros nas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i bum pa rnams dang ro gcig tu gyur/ oṃ haṃ hāṃ hiṃ hiṃ huṃ hūṃ hl̥ṃ hl̥̄ṃ <bum pa bcu'i sa bon > badzra padma a mṛ ta gha ṭa su bi shuddha dharma <rdo rje padma bdud rtsi'i bum pa shin tu rnam par dag pa > dhā tu swa bhā wa <chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin > sarba dharmā na <chos thams cad > su bi shuddha dharma dhā tu swa bhā wān ku ru ku ru ku swāhā/ <shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin du mdzod mdzod/> zhes pa mang du bzlas/ oṃ badzra gandhaṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ nas/ kā maṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ zhes pa'i bar mchod pa bcu gnyis phul nas/ dkyil 'khor gyis cha'i dbus dang shar la sogs pa rang gnas su bzhag par bya'o// 'dir bum rdzas bod du 'byor sla ba rnams bsdu na/ rin po che'i rigs ljang khu'am/ me tog ljang khu/ khab len/ dri'i rigs ga pur dang gla rtsi/ sman kaṇḍa ka ri/ 'bru yungs nag gro sran chung rnams rgyal ba'i bum par ro/ /rin po che'am me tog sngon po dang*/ gzhan snga ma dang 'dra ba rnams rnam rgyal bum par ro/ /bum rdzas de rnams cha gcig pa'o/ /mu men lcags me tog nag po/ dri sug rmel ka ko la/ dzā ti/ 'bru 'bras so ba dang til dkar/ sman rtag tu ngu*/ cha gnyis pa ste/ shar dang me'i bum par ro/ /byi ru/ zangs/ me tog dmar po/ dri gur gum/ sman tig ta/ spang spos/ lco ga mgo sman/ 'bru nas dang yungs dkar rnams/ cha gsum pa ste/ lho dang bden bral gyi bum par ro/ /shes dang*/ dung dang*/ mu tig dang*/ dngul dang*/ me tog dkar po dang*/ dri si hla/ a kar nag po/ tsan dan/ sman dbang lag

'bru zar ma/ mon sran/ khre rnams cha bzhi pa ste/ byang dang dbang ldan gyi bum par ro/ /rin po che dang*/ me tog ser po dang*/ gser dang*/ dri gla sgang*/ ru rta/ bā la/ pu shel rtsi/ sman de bā dā li/ sle tres/ 'bru til nag sran ma rnams cha lnga pa ste/ nub dang rlung gi bum par ro// lnga tshan lnga char gyi thum po rnam rgyal chen por gzhug go /rnam grangs gang mang yod pa la re res kyang rung ngo*/ /de nas thig skud rnams/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las srad bu āṃ īṃ ṝṃ ūṃ l̥̄ṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma la sogs pa yum lnga'i ngo bor gyur pa'i rdo rje'i srad bu'i rnam par gyur/ rang gi snying gar zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi steng du/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las/ dus kyi 'khor lo sna tshogs yum dang bcas par gsal ba'i yum gyi thugs ka'i nyi ma las rdo rje lcags kyu dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba spros nas/ yum lnga po rnams thig skud kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rdo rje'i srad bu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ oṃ āṃ īṃ ṝṃ ūṃ l̥̄ṃ badzra sū tra sarba dharma e ka swa bhā wa/ sarba dharmān e ka ā kā ra swa bhā wān ku ru ku ru swāhā/

zhes pa mang du bzlas/ badzra gandhaṃ nas/ kā maṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ bum pa'i shar du rol mos spyan drangs la bkod/ de nas rdul tshon rnams/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rdul tshon aṃ iṃ ṛṃ uṃ l̥ṃ rnams las byung ba'i/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i ngo bor gyur pa'i rdo rje rdul tshon gyi rnam par gyur/ rang gi snying gar zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi steng du/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las/ dus kyi 'khor lo sna tshogs yum dang bcas par gsal pa'i thugs ka'i zla ba las rdo rje lcags kyu dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba spros nas/ sangs rgyas lnga rdul tshon gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rdo rje rdul tshon rnams dang ro gcig tu gyur/ oṃ aṃ iṃ ṛṃ uṃ l̥ṃ su bi shuddha pañtsa skandhā swa bhā wa/ pañtsa skandhā na su bi shuddha dharmān ku ru ku ru swāhā/ mang du bzlas/ badzra gandhaṃ nas/ kā maṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ bum pa'i nub tu rol mos spyan drangs la bkod/ de nas rdo rje ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje hūṃ las byung ba'i dus kyi 'khor lo'i ngo bor gyur/ rang gi snying gar zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi steng du/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dus kyi 'khor lo sna tshogs yum dang bcas par gsal ba'i/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs ka'i zla ba las rdo rje lcags kyu dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba spros nas/ gtso bo ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rdo rje dang ro gcig tu gyur/ oṃ hūṃ kro dha badzra sarba satwa ka ru ṇa/ ātma ka sarba dhārma e ka su kha swa bhā ba/ sarba dharmān badzra su kha swa bhā bān ku ru ku ru swāhā/ mang du bzlas/ badzra gandhaṃ nas/ kā maṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ bum pa'i lhor rol mos spyan drangs la bkod/

de nas dril bu ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dril bu hoḥlas byung ba'i sna tshogs yum gyi ngo bor gyur/ rang gi snying gar zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi steng du/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las/ dus kyi 'khor lo sna tshogs yum dang bcas par gsal ba'i/ sna tshogs yum gyi thugs ka'i nyi ma las rdo rje lcags kyu dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba spros nas/ gtso mo ye shes sems dpa' dril bu'i rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dril bu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ oṃ hoḥbadzra ghaṇḍe sarba dharma e ka pradzñā dhā ni/ swa bhā wai/ sarba ā kā re/ sarba dharma pra bo dha ni/ sarba dharmānne/ swa bhā wai na pra bo dha ya pra bo dha ya swāhā/ mang du bzlas/ badzra gandhaṃ nas/ kā maṃ pra tī tstsha na maḥ bum pa'i byang gi char rol mos spyan drangs la bzhag par bya'o/ /de nas slob ma lhag gnas ni nyung ngu la yid ches pa'i gang zag la/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams kyi dgongs pa 'di kho nas chog ste/ maṇḍal phul zhing*/ mi bzad 'khor bas 'jigs pa bdag ni sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyis/ mngal du mngal gnas sdug bsngal sogs brjod cing*/ de'i don bshad pas snod du rung bar byas/ so shing dor/ yi ge drug pas bsrung ba byas te/ rdo rje sems dpa' bskul ba tsam bya'o/ /bdag 'jug gi tshe slob ma sta gon len pa'i srol yang yod pa sbyir nges par dgos pa ni ma yin kyang*/ byed par spro na bya'o/ /da lta slob ma sta gon cho ga gzhan dang bstun pa'i rgyas pa kho na phyag len la mdzad pas/ de bzhin ltar na/ bsam pa bcos shing nang dbang bskur/ /gsol btab sngags la spro ba bskyed/ /thun mong thun mong min sdom bzung*/ /bsrung ba gnas gsum byin rlabs mchod/ /so shing khyor chu ku sha dang*/ /bsrung skud sbyin nas rdor sems bskul/ /zab mos chos bshad rmi lam brtag

/ces pa ni sdom mo/ /de yang dang po slob mas phyag btsal maṇḍal phul/ slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces/ mngal du mngal gnas sdug bsngal dang ni btsa' ba'i dus dang byis pa'i dngos po la yang sdug bsngal te/ /gzhon nu lang tsho dag la bud med nor dang 'byor ba nyams pa nyon mongs sdug bsngal chen pos gang*/ /rga dang 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal nyid de slar yang 'gro ba drug tu ngu 'bod la sogs 'jigs ster ba/ /'gro ba 'di dag ma lus sgyu ma la rmongs gyur pas sdug bsngal las ni sdug bsngal 'dzin pa'o// 'khor bar mi nyid du ni rgya lam zhig na gyur kyang chos kyi blo ni rgya lam zhig na'o/ /de las dge ba'i dbang gis sangs rgyas la ni rjes chags gyur kyang dang po'i theg par rab tu 'jug /de las dpal ldan rdo rje theg pa sgom pa la ni blo gros ma lus 'jug pa rgya lam na'o/ /de phyir sangs rgyas nyid 'dod mchog gi bde ba'i go 'phang dag la 'jug pa e ma shin tu dka'/ / zhes brjod cing don bshad/ de nas/ rang nyid dus kyi 'khor lo yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od zer kyis slob ma rnams re re nas drangs zhing zhal nas zhugs/ yum gyi padmar zhu ba hūṃ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i dus 'khor zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gyur pa la rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang rang gi zhal nas zhugs pa/ snying gar rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems rdo rje'i lam nas 'thon pa rnams kyis dbang bskur/ yum kyi padma nas 'thon te rang rang gi gnas su 'khod par sgom mo/ / de nas slob mas/ skye rga 'chi ba na kra yi/ /chu srin la sogs 'jigs rung ba'i/ /srid pa'i mtsho las bdag sgrol mdzod/ /dga' chen ston pa khyod gcig pu/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul ston pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/

/sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ / zhes lan gsum kyis gsol ba btab/ bla mas/ bu tshur shog cig theg chen po'i/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje sngags kyi mthu yis ni// ye shes mnyam med yang dag brnyes/ /gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med pa// gang gi shākya seng ge sogs/ /mchog rnams kyis kyang bdud kyi sde/ /mi bzad chen po stobs chen bcom/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs nas ni/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig / ces pa'i don bshad de/ sngags la mos pa brtan po bskyed du gzhug go/ bla mas theg chen thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa'i rnam gzhag dang*/ bzung ba'i phan yon dang*/ ma bzung zhing ma srung ba'i nyes dmigs sogs legs par brda sprad/ slob mas kyang rjes zlos lan gsum byas te/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*/ / zhes lan gsum kyis thun mong gi sdom pa bzung*/ de nas/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang*/ /dam pa bdag la stsal nas ni/ /mgon po 'khor lo lha dag gi /de nyid slob dpon 'phrin las dang*/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*/ /sdom pa gsang mchog bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun gyi don sgrub phyir/ /bdag ni rten tu slob dpon bgyid/ / ces lan gsum kyis thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom bzung gi don du gsol ba gdab/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/

ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*/ /dge ba'i chos ni bsdud pa dang*/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung*/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba/ /padma'i rigs can dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*/ las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ / sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med mchog/dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgrol/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis sgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ / ces lan gsum gyis thun mong ma yin pa sngags kyi sdom pa bzung ngo*/ /de nas slob ma'i/ dpral bar zla ba la ū/ snying gar sgra gcan la ī/ gtsug tor du nam mkha' la ā/ lte bar dus me la l̥̄/ mgrin par nyi ma la ṝ/ gsang bar ye shes la aṃḥ rnams bsam du gzhug cing*/ slob ma'i snying mgrin dpral ba gsum la gdan snga ma dang 'dra ba la gnas pa'i hūṃ nag po dang*/ āḥ dmar po dang*/ oṃ dkar po bsam la/

mas rim gyis reg cing brjod de/ nyer spyod lngas mchod do/ /de nas u dum wa ra sogs 'o ma can gyi shing las skyes pa'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa srog chags med cing drang ba/ pags pa ma bshus shing ma gas la la/ rma med pa/ dri bzang gi chus bkrus shing*/ mgor me tog gi phreng ba bcings pa la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum gyis bsngags nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ kṣaḥ badzra danta kāṣṭha tsa tur bi mo kṣa mu kha bi shuddha swa bhā waṃ kā ya wāka tsitta dzñā na mu kha danta ā di ma lam bi sho dha ya bi sho dha ya swāhā/ zhes pas slob ma kha shar du phyogs pa la byin la/ khru bzhi pa'i tshad can gru bzhi pa ba byung lngas byugs pa'i maṇḍal la dor nas/ so shing gi mgo gang du phyogs pa de dang mthun par las rab 'byams 'grub par go bar bya'o/ /de nas dri bzang po'i chu bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas pa khyor ba gsum/ oṃ hrīḥbi shuddha dharma sarba pā paṃ nishtsa a sya sho dha ya sarba bi kalpān a pa na ya hūṃ/ zhes pas blud do/ /de nas ku sha gnyis bsangs la/ che ba hūṃ las skye shing hūṃ bzlas pa stan dang*/ chung ba dhīḥ las skyes shing de bzlas pa sngas kyi don du slob ma'i lag pa gnyis su/ oṃ badzra tīkṣ+ṇa baṃ zhes brjod de sbyin/ de nas slob ma'i lus tshad mnyam pa'i skud pa dmar po bsangs sbyangs te/ hūṃ las byung zhing hūṃ lan bdun bzlas te mdud pa gsum byas pa/ oṃ buddha mai trī rakṣa rakṣa sarbān swāhā/ zhes brjod de slob ma'i dpung pa la bcing ngo*/ /slob ma'i dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ/ mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la āḥ snying khar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la hūṃ/ lte bar dus ma'i dkyil 'khor la hoḥ gtsug tor du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la haṃ/ gsang bar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la kṣaḥ bkod de/ oṃ a āḥ.aṃ aḥbadzra satwa mahā su kha kā la tsakra shi ṣya sya a bhi mu kho bhā wa santu ṣtāo bhā wa/

kā ya wā ka tsitta a dhiṣṭhā naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes brjod de rdo rje sems dpa' bskul bas slob ma'i sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas mchog stsol bar bsam mo/ / 'jig rten na ni kun mkhyen rnams/ /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ /rgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gi sems can mnyam med don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma ru/ /sngon du sdig pa byas pa yang*// dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag thams cad zad 'gyur na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med pa 'grub/ /gang gi spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /ngan 'gro de yis gcod par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /gang gi rgyal ba sras bcas pas/ / bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin par// bdag nyid chen po khyed gnas te/ /de yis khyed rnams theg chen du/ /sangs ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ khyed rnams der ni dong bas na/ /rang 'byung skal ba chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de gzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur/ / zhes pa'i don bshad pas spro ba bskyed/ bla ma'am dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su mgo bstan te nyol la/ tho rangs nam gyi bzhi cha la rmi lam gang mthong ba de kho bo la smros shig ces bsgos nas slob ma rang gnas su btang ngo*/ /sngar gyi rdzas lnga dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs ma 'chol bar yod pa de'i ngang du/ slob dpon gyi mal stan lhag gnas bya ba'i phyir du dkyil 'khor kyi sa'i lho phyogs su mgo bo nub tu bstan pas mtshan ma brtag pa'i don du/

oṃ hoḥbadzra ka ma la da la garbhe sha yye badzra su kha mahā ni trāṃ ka ro mi ya thā ta thā ga te na kṛ tā haḥswāhā/ zhes pa mang du bzlas nas nyal bar bya'o/ /de dag ni gsol ba btab pa dang*/ lhag gnas bdun te nyi ma gnyis pa'i bya ba'o/ /de la rmi lam dge ba'i mtshan ma mthong na ni legs/ ci yang ma mthong na 'bring yin pas/ nangs par nas thig 'debs pa sogs dkyil 'khor 'dri ba la 'jug mtshan ma ngan pa mthong na re zhig bzlog pa'i thabs la 'bad par gsungs kyang*/ da ltar gyi rdo rje slob dpon sems rnam g.yeng ngang gi grangs bsnyen song ba tsam la skyabs su byed pa rnams kyis/ dngos grub 'byung ba'i mtshan ma yang mthong ba dkon pa dang*/ bar chad yod kyang de'i mtshan ma rtogs pa dka' bas/ rmi lam ngan pa ma mthong yang*/ bar chad bzlog thabs 'di dag byas na legs shing*/ 'di yang dngos su slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs kho na la gsungs kyang*/ dgos don 'dra ba'i phyir/ sgrub mchod bdag 'jug dang bcas pa tsam la'ang 'grub na bya zhing*/ yang 'di slob dpon du 'os pa kho na'i bya ba yin mod kyang*/ dkyil 'khor 'bri sgrub sogs cho ga gzhan la'ang mtshungs pas/ cho ga la zhugs pa thams cad kyis byas na legs shing*/ slob dpon kho na'i bya bar grags pa gzhan 'ga' zhig kyang de dang 'dra'o/ /

zhes bla ma dam pa man ngag rig pa dag gsung pa ni shin tu 'thad par rtogs so/ /de'i tshul ni/ haṃ las byung ba'i nam mkha'i rang bzhin zhes pa nas/ 'byung po'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol gyi bar/ bsrung 'khor rgyas par sgom pa mngon rtogs bzhin las/ bar der mkha' 'gro ma'i gtor ma brgya phrag sogs ci nus su btang*/ slar yang sgrub thabs su bshad pa bzhin gyi sngon 'gro byas nas/ logs su bshad pa ltar rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor rkang pa bcu drug pa dang*/ /rkang pa bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa'i bzlas pa ci nus su bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi nub tu slob dpon kha shar du phyogs shing rkang pa g.yon skyil krung phyed pa dang*/ g.yas kyi mthil sa la bzhag cing*/ pus mo steng du son pa'i 'dug stangs bya/ khu tshur g.yon pas thig skud bzung*/ slob ma shar nas de las bzlog pa'i tshul gyis gnas pas/ khu tshur g.yas par 'dzin du bcug la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ kā ya wāka tsitta e ka bhū hāḥsarba dharmā e kā kā re ṇa badzra satwo haṃ/ badzra bhū mi sū tra ya mi hūṃ aḥphaṭa/ thig skud brkyang pa'i sngags so/ / oṃ badzra sū tra e kā kā ra swa ru pe ṇa dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥsarba dharmāṃ sū tra ya oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ kṣaḥphaṭa/ thig skud gdab pa'i sngags so/ /de ltar tshangs thig dang po 'debs pa ste/ gzhan rnams kyang 'di'i rig pas shes la/ 'on kyang yongs 'jom spang ba'i phyir byad dang dbang ldan dang shar dang me rnams su slob dpon mi 'gro zhing*/ lhag mar slob ma yang ngo*/ /shing bu khṛ gang gi tshad dang sor drug gi tshad ma 'khrul ba byas la/ de nas 'di ltar/ maṇḍal dbus su phur bu bzung bya ste/ gru bzhi'i mtha' nas dang por zlum por skor/ /de'i tshad du tshangs pa'i thig gnyis gdab/ /cha chung drug gis lhag pa'i gru bzhi'i mthar/ /bskor ba'i tshad du zur gyi thig gnyis gdab/ /tshangs thig rtse nas tshangs thig gzhan gyi rtser/

/logs gtub byas pas sku yi rtsa thig rnyed/ /rtsa thig 'di dang tshangs thig 'phrad mtshams nas/ /log gtub byas pas gsung gi rtsa thig rnyed/ /de bzhin gsum pas thugs kyi rtsa thig rnyed/ /bzhi pas bde ba chen po rnyed par 'gyur/ /lnga pas gtso bo'i gnas kyi phyi mtha' gdung*/ /thugs kyi mda' thig thugs gsung rtsa thig bar/ /gsung gi mda' thig gsung sku'i rtsa thig phyed/ /sku yi mda' thig zur thig rtse mo sbrel/ /de rnams rlon thig go /gsum char rtsa thig mda' thig bar gyi sa/ /gang yin de ni phyed du bgo bya zhing*/ /de yi nang ma dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ /phyi ma phyed gdab de yi phyi yang phyed/ /rtsa thig nang gi sa yang phyed mar bgo /de rnams skam thig go /bde chen 'khor lo'i phyi nang thig gnyis kyi/ /bar la mtha' gnyis su ni drug cha gdab/ /nang gi gdung sna 'then pas ka ba brgyad/ /tshangs thig g.yas g.yon cha phran gnyis gnyis bor/ /sboms su cha phran gcig pa'i ka thig bri/ /sgo tshad bzhi pa'i dbus dor drug cha gdab// bde chen 'khor lo'i tshad kyi ka ba'i thig /tshangs thig g.yas g.yon de la cha gnyis bgo /dang po phyed gdab phyi phyed gnyis pa bzhi/ /skam thig go /rtsa ba'i phyi las dang po gsum par reg /de yi rtse nas logs su lnga pa'i bar/ /de yi rtse nas phyi ru mda' yab thig /zur nas ngos su thig lnga yod pa las/ /dang po gnyis ni gnyis reg rtse mo sbrel/ /lhag ma gsum ni bdun pa la reg cing*/ /tshangs las drug bdun bzung nas mda' yab reg /thugs dkyil lo/ /gsung gi sgo tshad bzhi pa gong dang mtshungs/ /dbus kyi padma'i tshad du sgo khyud thig /rta babs ka ba thugs kyi rtsa thig tshad/ /gsung dkyil lo/ /rtsa thig nang dang sgo tshad bzhi pa'i nang*/ bcu gnyis cha re rab tu gdab bar bya/ /sgo khyud thig ni bde chen 'khor lo'i tshad/ /sgo 'grams thugs kyi mda' yab tshad nas drangs/ /rta babs ka ba gsung gi rtsa thig tshad/

/gsum ka sgo dbye tshul dang rta babs ni/ /'dra ste cha ni rang rang tshad kyi rtse/ /rta babs don du sgo tshad rnam gsum gdab/ /tshangs thig sgo tshad gcig tu skam thig drangs/ /sgo tshad 'og ma'i nang mthar sum cha dang*/ /de yang gnyis su bgos shing bar ma yang*// dbus dor mtha' gnyis bzhi cha re re gdab/ /bzhi cha gnyis la'ang nang du sum cha re/ /sgo tshad phyi ma gsum phyed dbus ma yi/ /ma mthar bzhi cha btab cing tshangs thig las/ /ngos su sgo tshad bzhi po re re la/ /drug drug phye bas cha phran nyer bzhi 'byung*/ /skam thig go /mda' thig phyi las bcu gnyis ngos su ste/ /tshangs pa'i thig gi g.yas dang g.yon ngos su/ /bcu gnyis brgyad dgu slar yang dgu dang drug /phyed bcas bdun pa zung dang bzhi dang drug /drug dang bzhi gnyis thig gi dkyus su'o// ka ba phyi ma'i phyi thig myos srung mnyam/ /gdung bzhi myos srung gsum dang bum pa'i gnas/ /rang rang thig gi sne nas 'og tu bcad/ /gnyis gsum bar du tshangs las gnyis pa dang*/ /me ri klu yi steng du bcad par bya/ /lnga drug bar du gzugs mig mtshams dang ni /mig mda'i phyi ru cha chung bzhi cha gcod/ /de bzhin ngos kyi drug pa'i steng nas drangs/ /brgyad dgu'i bar du dang po dang gnyis phyed// gsum bzhi'i mtshams dang bzhi par rlon thig gdab/ /bcu gcig thig sne bcu pa'i lnga par sbrel// tshangs thig mtha' ni myos srung steng ma'i thig/de nas khor yug dang po'i nang thig skor/ /de nas sgo tshad phyed gcig gzugs zla phyed/ /ri bong can gyi khor yug rim bzhin skor/ /nam mkha'i khor yug dbus su sum cha skor/ /rdo rje 'phreng ba'i gnas yin me rlung gi /mtshams te phan tshun phyed ni dur khrod gnas/ /dbus kyi gdung nang tshangs thig g.yas g.yon du/ /sum cha dang ni gdung la reg par skor/ /bde gshegs 'phar ma'i phyogs mtshams cha chung bzhi/ /bar gyi ka ba'i bar du cha gsum bskor/

/thugs kyi lha snam zur bcad de nang dang*/ /lhag ma cha gsum mnyam pa dbus nas bzung*// cha bzhi zlum skor sgo bzhir de dang mtshungs/ /gsung gi zur bzhir de dang 'dra ba ste/ /phyogs bzhi padma thugs kyi rta babs kyi/ /brtsegs ma bar ma'i re'u dbus ma la/ /steng 'og snam bu'i phyed du za bar bya/ /sku yi padma thugs kyi rigs 'dra yang*/ /padma bdun cha skor thig rim pa bzhi/ /sgo bzhi dang ni shar nub rtags babs rtser/ /sgo tshad phyed kyi shing rta gru bzhi re/ /dur khrod gnas su'ang 'khor lo sgo tshad phyed/ /tshangs zur thig nas skam thig drangs steng gdab/ /shar nub gnyis su nyis rim dgod par bya/ /sgo khyud phyi yi stegs bur 'byung bzhi bri/ /padma'i 'dab ma rnams dang 'khor lo'i rtsibs/ /thig gdab spyi dang mtshungs par shes par bya/ /bzhi brgyad bcu drug sku yi pad 'dab grangs/ /de nas skam thig ma lus dbye bar bya/ /'di dag zhib mor lag len man ngag bzhin/ /ma 'khrul shin tu snyom pa ra gdab par bya/ /mthar thig skud la mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod// thig skud ye shes pa rang gi snying khar thim/ nyi ma gsum pa'i bya ba'o/ /slar yang dkyil 'khor gy-i sa gzhi la mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod cing*/ rdul tshon la yang mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ spro na sa'i lha mo'i gtor ma yang phul/ de nas slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug ste/ 'di ni chos nyid dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /rang nyid rgyal po rdo rje 'chang*/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnam par grol/ /'khor lo'i nang du yang dag gnas/ /oṃ badzra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing*/ thugs dkyil gyi dbang ldan nas brtsams te g.yas skor gyis tshon dgye zhing*/ phyi nas slob mas kyang ngo*/ /tshigs bcad dang sngags de yang cho ga gzhan dang sgo bstun pa'o/ /mthar 'dri ba'i bya ba rdzogs nas/

rdul mtshon gyi lhag ma la yang mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ rdul tshon ye shes pa rang gi snying gar thim/ thig gi rnam gzhag rgyas pa dang*/ /tshon gyi mtshan nyid mtha' dag ni dbang chog chen mo las shes par bya zhing*/ nyi ma 'di dag la zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ci 'grub tu bya'o/ /nyi ma bzhi pa dang lnga pa'i bya ba'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ dkyil 'khor legs par bris zin pa na/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te bum pa'i sngags bzla bzhin du bum pa 'god te/ bum pa bcu yod na brgyad po phyogs mtshams brgyad du bkod/ rgyal ba shar gyi shar dang*/ rnam par rgyal ba nub kyi nub tu sor gnyis spangs par bkod/ rgyal ba'i steng du rnam rgyal chen po bzhag nya phy-is sam dung chos kyi snod du/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dngos sam/ bdud rtsi ril bu lta bu bzhag la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ kṣaḥ lan bdun bsngags te 'jog par bshad pa/ lag len la rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa'i steng du 'jog ci te bum pa lnga yin na/ phyogs bzhir re re/ shar kyi bum pa las sor gnyis spangs pa'i shar du rgyal ba'i bum pa dang*/ de'i steng du dung chos ni rnam rgyal yin la/ bdud rtsi lnga ni nub kyi bum pa'i steng du'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du sa'i stegs bu la ba byung dang*/ dri bzang gi maṇḍal bya zhing*/ rgyal ba'i bum pa'i mdun du'ang khru gang gi maṇḍal lhag por bya'o/ /de dag ma 'grub na'ang mchod pa rgya cher bshams shing*/ kha dog lnga'i ba dan dang*/ sa rgyan gnam rgyan/ gtor ma dang gos zung la sogs pa 'og tu dgos pa'i mchod rdzas dang dbang rdzas de dag tshogs par byas la/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma bzhi la rdo rje dril bu dang bka'i gnang ba sbyin te/ sgo'i rdo rje slob dpon du bzhagaslob ma bzang po lnga pa ni sbyin bsreg bya ba'i don du dang*/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi yang bum pa skyong ba'i don du mtshams bzhir dgod par bya ste/

de dag kyang dngos su med na yid kyis bya zhing*/ sbyin bsreg kyang rang nyid kyis bya bar bshad do/ /de la cho ga bya ba'i rim pa ni sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs nas/ klu dang rab gtum ma rnams gshegs su gsol/ zhes bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor lus la bsdu ba'i bar gong bzhin/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i rang bzhin rtsibs bcu pa zlum po'i dbus su zhes pa nas/ bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag phyed pa dang*/ de'i yang nang gi phyed du/ sāṃ ṣāṃ shāṃ yongs su gyur pa las gtso bo'i padma rgyar dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga pa dang*/ de'i lte ba la aṃ yig las byung ba'i zla ba dang*/ āḥyig las byung ba'i nyi ma dang*/ a yig las byung ba'i sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa ste/ zhes pa nas/ bde gshegs 'phar ma'i shar dang thugs kyi shar sgor tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ me mtshams su tsā tshā dzā dzha nyā/ thugs kyi lha snam gyi shar gyi g.yas su tsaṃ tshaṃ dzaṃ dzhaṃ nyaṃ/ shar lhor tsaḥtshaḥdzaḥdzhaḥnyaḥ bde gshegs 'phar ma'i lho dang thugs kyi lho sgor ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ bden bral du ṭā ṭhā ḍā ḍhā ṇā/ thugs kyi lha snam gyi lho'i g.yas su ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ/ lho nub tu ṭaḥṭhaḥḍaḥḍhaḥṇaḥ bde gshegs 'phar ma'i byang dang thugs kyi byang sgor pa pha ba bha ma/ dbang ldan du pā phā bā bhā mā/ thugs kyi lha snam gyi byang gi g.yas su paṃ phaṃ baṃ bhaṃ maṃ/ byang shar du paḥphaḥbaḥbhaḥmaḥ bde gshegs 'phar ma'i nub dang thugs kyi nub bskor ta tha da dha na/ rlung mtshams su tā thā dā dhā nā/ thugs kyi lha snam la nub kyi g.yas su taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ/ nub byang du taḥthaḥdaḥdhaḥnaḥ thugs kyi lha snam la lho'i g.yon du kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ ngaṃ*/ nub kyi g.yon du kā khā gā ghā ngā*/

shar gyi g.yon du sa ྉྤ ṣa sha ྈྐ/ byang gi g.yon du saḥྉྤཿṣaḥshaḥྈྐཿrnams yongs su gyur pa las padma'i gdan rnams te/ thams cad kyang rtsa ba dang*/ sdong bu dang 'dab ma dang ge sar dang snying po rnams yongs su rdzogs pa/ sa bon re re las byung ba ste/ bde gshegs 'phar ma'i phyogs bzhi dang*/ thugs kyi lha snam la/ shar dang lho'i g.yas dang g.yon gnyis kar dang*/ byang dang nub kyi g.yas dang*/ shar dang byang gi sgo rnams su padma dkar po'o/ /bde gshegs 'phar ma dang thugs kyi 'khor lo'i mtshams rnams dang*/ byang dang nub kyi g.yon dang*/ lho dang nub kyi sgo rnams su padma dmar po'o/ /padma dmar po bcu gnyis kyi lte bar lo'i phyogs nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i nya bcu gnyis rnam par dag pa/ ha yig las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis dang*/ dkar po bcu gnyis kyi lte bar gnam stong bcu gnyis rnam par dag pa kṣa yig las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nas/ bkra ba du mas mdzes par gyur/ dbus kyi gdan kyi steng du gtso bo'i mtshan ma lhar gyur pa ni/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa dang*/ de las byung ba'i dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dri ma med pa'i 'od zer rnam pa lnga/ zhes pa nas/ dpag bsam gyi shing ser po rnams su gyur/ gyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin las/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can zhes pa dang*/ sna tshogs yum gyi rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can zhes pa 'dir mi dgos/ gtso bo'i thugs kar a dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog sngon po nas/ rang dang 'dra ba'i sher phyin mas 'khyud pa 'i bar las rgyal mchog bzhin/ bde gshegs 'phar ma'i mtshan ma rnams lhar gyur pa ni/ i yig las byung ba'i ral gri nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ don yod grub pa nas/ 'og tu rdul 'gags pa'i bum pa rnams su gyur/ gyi bar mngon rtogs dang 'dra ba las/

'khod par gyur zhes pa thams cad la bzhugs pa'o zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ sgo'i mtshan ma rnams lhar gyur pa ni/ yaṃ yig las byung ba'i ral gri nas/ thabs gtso bor gyur pa pa'o 'i bar la 'khod par gyur zhes pa rnams la bzhugs par gyur/ thugs kyi lha snam gyi mtshan ma rnams lhar gyur pa ni/ a yig las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu nas/ sgra rdo rje ma rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog sngon mo zhes pa nas/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa' ོ'i bar te 'khod par gyur rnams la bzhugs pa'o/ / zhes 'don pa spo/ zhes pa nas/ gzungs ma grangs med pa dang bcas pa'o/ /gsung gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha snam la gnas pa'i mtshan ma rnams lhar gyur pa ni/ ha yig las byung ba'i gri gug nas/ gzhon nu ma 'khor dang bcas pa ni gdong drug pa'o/ /sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha snam la gnas pa'i mtshan ma rnams lhar gyur pa ni/ nya nyi nyaṃ/ zhes pa nas/ gzhon nu 'khor dang bcas pa ni gdong drug pa'o/ /sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgo la gnas pa'i mtshan ma rnams lhar gyur pa ni/ ya yig las byung ba'i dbyug pa nag po nas/ khro bo'i lha mo rnams g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas pa'o/ /sku'i stegs bu la rta babs kyi ka ba'i nang rol na gnas pa'i mtshan ma rnams lhar gyur pa ni/ hya hyā las byung ba'i

nas/ rin po che 'dzin pa'o/ /dur khrod 'khor lo'i mtshan ma rnams lhar gyur pa ni/ dang gri gug nas/ sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa rnams kyang 'khod par gyur/ gsung gi stegs bu'i mtshan ma rnams lhar gyur pa ni/ tsaḥtshaḥdzaḥdzñaḥnyaḥrnams yongs su gyur pa las/ sgrol ma las byung ba'i nas/ nub sgo'i g.yon gyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa'o/ /sku'i stegs bu'i mtshan ma rnams lhar gyur pa ni/ tsaṃ tshaṃ dzaṃ dzhaṃ nyaṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa nas/ sems can bslu bar mi 'dod ma rnams nub sgo'i g.yon gyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa'o/ / zhes pa de rnams ni dam tshig pa bskyed pa'o/ /de nas/ bdag nyid kyi thugs kar hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa dang*/ de las byung ba'i rdo rje shugs/ zhes pa nas/ gtsug tor du ha las thugs rdo rje rnams 'khod par gyur/ de ltar dbang bskur bas dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs te rgyas btab par gyur pa ni/ gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ sna tshogs yum la mi bskyod pas rgyas btab/ rnam par snang mdzad la mi bskyod pa nas/ gzhom du med pa'i a yig go / lhag gnas kyi skabs su/ sems 'grel rnams kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dgongs pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la mchod cing gsol ba btab nas/ 'gro 'ong med pa'i tshul gyis gshegs su gsol ba'i phyogs la ni/ 'dir sta gon gyi lha dang sre mi dgos te/ gsol ba btab pa'i lha rnams ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du zhugs zin pas so/ /bsdus rgyud gzhan gyi dgongs pa 'phags yul gyi paṇa grub mang pos bkral ba ltar na/ lhag gnas kyi lha rnams nam mkhar 'degs pa shas che zhing rang gi snying khar bsdu ba dang*/ rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs pa'ang yod mod kyi/ skabs 'di'i gong 'og ci rigs par 'jug par bzhed de/ de'i tshul la mos na ni rdo rje phreng ba sogs las rtogs par bya zhing*/ bar 'dir spro na mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa yang cung zad bya'o/

/de dag ni dkyil 'khor rab tu gnas pa'o/ /de nas mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ gong bzhin mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad mchod pa'i yul du/ zhes pa nas/ shi ṣyā ṇāñtsa/ zhes pa'i bar gong gsol ba gdab pa'i skabs bzhin no/ /skabs 'dir maṇḍal rnams kyi steng du dngos su mchod pa rgya cher 'bul zhing*/ mchod yon gyi snod du yang rung ste/ lha thams cad kyi mtshan nas smos te 'bul ba yin zhing*/ mtshan rnams ni legs sbyar gyi skad dag por 'don shes na mchog yin mod kyang*/ dka' tshegs che la ma dag pa'i rgya skad du rlom pa bas/ bod skad nyid tshegs chung shing don la 'byor bas/ oṃ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la na maḥ oṃ sna tshogs yum la na maḥ zhes sogs kyis mtshon no// skabs 'dir dkyus 'gro nyid bshad par bya ste/ rnam dag ye shes bdud rts-i'i chu gter ni/ /rab dwangs kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs/ /zhal gyi rnyog pa'i dri sel yon chab 'di/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul/ /oṃ āḥhrī pra wa ra sad kā raṃ arthaṃ añtsa ma naṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ tshig rkang dang po gnyis 'dra ba la/ zhabs kyi padma'i dri sel spos kyi chu/ / zhes pa dang*/ pādyaṃ/ de bzhin du/ kun tu 'pho ba'i gdung sel 'thor 'thung 'di/ /pro kṣa naṃ/ yan lag brgyad ldan rdo rje arghaṃ'i rgyun/ /arghaṃ zhes pas chu bzhi phul/ de nas mchod pa bcu gnyis la/ yo byad kyis mchod pa ni/ khams gsum dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das/ / sogs gong bzhin no/ /lha mos mchod pa ni/ tsa sde thung ring las skyes pa'i/ /dri chab ma dang phreng ba ma/ /nam mkha' khyab pa'i tshogs sprul te/ /dkyil 'khor lha la mchod par 'bul/ /oṃ badzra gandhe gandha artsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/

<rdo rje dri mas dri'i mchod pa rnams mdzod mdzod/> oṃ badzra mā le mā la artsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ <rdo rje phreng ba mas phreng ba'i mchod pa rnams mdzod mdzod/> ṭa sde thung ring las skyes pa'i/ /bdug spos ma dang snang gsal ma/ /nam mkha' khyab pa'i tshogs sprul te/ /dkyil 'khor lha la mchod par 'bul/ /oṃ badzra dhū pe dhū pa artsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ <rdo rje bdug spos mas bdug spos kyi mchod pa rnams mdzod mdzod/> oṃ badzra pra dī pe pra dī pa artsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ <rdo rje sgron me mas sgron ma'i mchod pa rnams mdzod mdzod/> pa sde thung ring las skyes pa'i/ /zhal zas ma dang 'bras bu ma/ /nam mkha' khyab pa'i tshogs sprul te/ /dkyil 'khor lha la mchod par 'bul/ /oṃ badzra a mṛ te nai wi tya pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ <rdo rje bdud rtsi mas zhal zas kyi mchod pa rnams mdzod mdzod/> oṃ badzra akṣa te akṣa ta pha la artsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ <rdo rje ma nyams mas ma nyams pa'i 'bras bu'i mchod pa rnams mdzod mdzod/> ta sde thung ring las skyes pa'i/ /sgeg mo dang ni bzhad pa ma/ /nam mkha' khyab pa'i tshogs sprul te/ /dkyil 'khor lha la mchod par 'bul/ /oṃ badzra lā sye wast+ra a bha ra ṇa pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ <rdo rje sgeg mos gos rgyan gyi mchod pa rnams mdzod mdzod/> oṃ badzra hā sya ghaṇḍa ā dar sha pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ <rdo rje bzhad mas dril bu me long gi mchod pa rnams mdzod mdzod/> ka sde thung ring las skyes pa'i/ /sil snyan ma dang gar mkhan ma/ /nam mkha' khyab pa'i tshogs sprul te/ /dkyil 'khor lha la mchod par 'bul/ /oṃ badzra bā dye bā dyaṃ pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ <rdo rje sil snyan mas sil snyan gyi mchod pa rnams mdzod mdzod/> oṃ badzra nṛ tye nṛ tyaṃ pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/

<rdo rje gar mas gar gyi mchod pa rnams mdzod mdzod/> sa sde thung ring las skyes pa'i/ /glu dbyangs ma dang 'dod pa ma/ /nam mkha' khyab pa'i tshogs sprul te/ /dkyil 'khor lha la mchod par 'bul/ /oṃ badzra gī te gī taṃ pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ <rdo rje glu mas glu'i mchod rnams mdzod mdzod mdzod/> oṃ badzra kā me <rdo rje 'dod mas > sarba <thams cad > buddha <sangs rgyas > bo dhi <byang chub > satwā nāṃ <sems dpa' rnams > kro dha ā dī nāṃ <khro bo la sogs pa rnams kyi > badzra su ra ta pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ <rdo rje shin tu dga' ba'i mchod pa rnams mdzod mdzod/> srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ /mi phyed rdo rje'i sku brnyes la/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ shrī kā la tsakra sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥbadzra bast+ra āḥhūṃ/ rab 'bar nor bu rin chen inda snyil/ / gser dngul la sogs rin chen me tog dang*/ /reg na bde ba rnam mang gos kyi tshogs/ /tsandan la sogs dri bzang sbyar ba'i chab/ /dri zhim bdug spos bsregs pa'i sprin tshogs dang*/ /rtsi bcud 'bru mar dang bcas sgron me'i tshogs/ /grags stong gnyis su med pa'i dril bu'i sgra/ /gsal snang gzugs brnyan 'char ba'i me long dang*/ /lha rdzas bla bre nam mkha'i tshad 'jal byed/ /rnam mang 'bras bu sna tshogs bcud gter zhing*/ /lhab lhub g.yo ba ba dan rnam lnga'i tshogs/ /'jo sgeg rnam 'gyur spro ba'i gar mkhan dang*/ /sgra snyan sna tshogs rol mo'i mchod pa ste/ /bcu gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /yan lag bcu gnyis 'pho ba rab 'gags nas/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥshrī kā la tsakra maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ tra yo da sha pū dza me gha sa mu dra sphā ra ṇa sa ma ya na maḥ rab dwangs yan lag brgyad ldan chu gtsang dang*/

/'o chab me tog bcas pa'i mchod yon bzang*/ /rlung gis bskyod pa'i dri bzang mkha' khyab dang*/ /lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba'i bdug spos dang*/ /utpal padma la sogs me tog bkra/ /ma nyams sa ha ka ra'i 'bras bu smin/ /sman mchog dbang po la sogs 'bru sna tshogs/ /nyi zla nor bu la sogs snang gsal tshogs/ / bdud rtsi ro brgya ldan pa'i lha bshos dang*/ /kañtsa li ka lha yi gos kyi mchog / mchod pa rnam bcu phul bas sa bcu thob/ /dkyil 'khor rnam bcu sgrib bral thob par shog /oṃ āḥhūṃ sogs gong gi sngags dang 'dra ba las/ tra yo da sha zhes pa'i tshab tu wa hya da sha zhes pa 'jug ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ bkra shis dpal be'u g.yung drung 'khyil/ /dge ba'i don du mnga' ba ltar/ /de bzhin bdag kyang dbul bar bgyi/ /ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ /gser gyi 'khor lo mu khyud can/ /tshangs pa chen pos phul ba ltar/ /de bzhin bdag kyang dbul bar bgyi/ / ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ /'dam gyi skyon gyis ma gos pa'i/ /padma dkar po phul ba ltar/ /de bzhin bdag kyang 'bul bar bgyi/ /ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ /nyon mongs bdud las rgyal ba yi/ /chos kyi rgyan mtshan phul ba ltar/ / de bzhin bdag kyang dbul bar bgyi/ /ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ / gdugs dkar gser gyi yu ba can/ / phul ba de bzhin bdag 'bul na/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ /re ba thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa'i/ /bum pa bzang po phul ba ltar/ /de bzhin bdag kyang dbul bar bgyi/ /ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ /snyan pa phyogs bcur sgrog pa yi/ /'bud dung g.yas 'khyil phul ba ltar/ /de bzhin bdag kyang dbul bar bgyi/ /ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ / na bza' gsar gyi nya ris can/ / phul ba de bzhin bdag 'bul na/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ / de nas rgyal srid sna bdun ni/

bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /'khor lo rin chen 'di 'bul bas/ / zhes sogs tshigs bcad spyi khyab las/ 'bul sngags gong gis rigs 'gre/ de bzhin du/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan/ / sogs spyi khyab dang mthun pas 'dod yon lnga phul/ de nas bkra shis rdzas brgyad ni/ dri med chos kun gsal ba'i me long dang*/ /g.yas 'khyil chos sgra mi zad sgrog pa'i dung*/ /dug gsum nyon mongs 'joms pa'o gi haṃ dang*/ rtsi bcud snying po bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin zho/ khams gsum dbang du sdud pa li khri'i rdzas/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe sgrub dur ba'i rtswa/ /don mchog bla med sgrub pa bil ba'i 'bras/ /bgegs dang bar chad kun 'joms yungs kar te/ /rgyal bas byin rlabs bkra shis rdzas brgyad po/ /phul bas 'gro la dge legs 'phel bar shog /madga la aṣta dra bya/ bum pa 'bul ba ni/ nag po ra ri med pa yi/ /bum pa lto che bre tshad pa/ /mchu 'phyang mgrin ring gdan dang ldan/ /mgrin pa ras bzang dag gis dkris/ /snying por ldan pa'i sman sogs bcug /'dab mar ldan pa'i lcug ma yang*/ /dri ngad ldan pa'i kha rgyan can/ /bdud rtsir ldan pa yis kyang mchod/ /gha ṭa pū ra/ de nas dam rdzas 'bul ba ni/ ga pur gla rtsi rkang dang bzhi mnyam dang*/ /stobs dang mchin pa mkhris pa nyi ma dang*/ /rgyu ma pags pa rnams te rdzas bcu po/ /phul bas pha rol phyin bcu thob par shog /da sha sa ma ya bhuñdza tha/ yum lnga'i rang bzhin mchog tu rnam dag pa'i/ khu ba bshang gci khrag dang sha rnams dang*/ /byang chub sems ma drug gis rnam dag pa'i/ /rna ba sna dang mig dang lce dbang po/ /bshang lam pho mo'i dbang po'i dam tshig dang*/ /rnal 'byor ma brgyad rnams kyis rnam dag pa/ / rnag dang bad kan shig dang srin bu dang*/ /chu ser dang ni zhag dang ba spu skra/ khro mo bcu yis rnam dag dam tshig ni/ /rgyu ma mkhris pa rus pa rkang mar dang*/

/ mchin pa glo ba rtsa dang pags pa dang*/ /snying dang tshil bu las byung bdud rtsi bcud/ /rnam dag rang bzhin rab gtum bcu po yis/ /mig rna sna lce bha ga bshang lam dang*/ /rtags dang mchan khung las byung dri ma brgyad/ /de ltar dam rdzas sum cu rtsa bdun gyis/ /bde chen dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor mchod/ / byang chub phyogs chos sum cu rtsa bdun thob/ /sum cu bdun pa'i lha tshogs rab 'grub nas/ /'gro kun bde chen gnas la 'god par shog /sabta tring shad sa ma ya bhuñdza tha/ de nas nang mchod 'bul ba dngos ni/ gong gsol btab kyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin no/ /mdun skyed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi sku la/ rigs drug dgod pa dang*/ mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab pa rnams yid kyis dran par byas nas/ oṃ dzñā na pū dza a nu rakto swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas gsang ba'i mchod pa phul/ de nas mchod pa sna tshogs pa 'bul ba ni/ nyon mongs ma lus bcom pa'i stag lpags dang*/ /sgrib pa kun bral glang chen pags pa'i gos/ /'jigs byed he ru ka dpal mnyes byed pa/ /sna tshogs na bza'i mchod pa 'bul bar bgyi/ /dbang sngon karke ta na chu shel dang*/ /pad dmar ma ra ka ta mu tig dang*/ /dzambu chu bo'i gser dang dngul la sogs/ /bza' dang bca' ba rnam pa sna tshogs dang*/ /rtsa ba sdong bu 'dab ma me tog dang*/ /ljon shing la sogs rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /bsod nams spel phyir dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /ral gri khang pa pags pa skyed mos tshal/ /mal cha gos dang mchil lham rin po che/ /padma can sogs bkra shis lha mo brgyad/ /sna tshogs rin chen las grub khang bzang dang*/ /dpag bsam shing dang bum pa bzang po dang*/ / 'dod 'jo'i ba dang rin chen ri bo sogs/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod/ /dbang bskur dngos grub don du ni/ /lha dang bla ma mchod pa'i phyir/ /tsha mo dang ni bu mo dang*/ /sring mo de bzhin skyed byed ma/

/de bzhin chung ma'i ma dang ni/ /de bzhin zhang po'i bud med dang*/ /pha yi spun zla'i chung ma dang*/ /de bzhin pha yi sring mo dang*/ /rang gi ma yi spun zla nyid/ khyim pa'i rigs kyis dbul bar bsngags/ /rig ma bcu yis mchod par bgyi/ /dbang bskur ba dang dngos grub don/ /dge slong dge tshul rnams la ni/ /bla mas sbyin par bya ba ste/ /lha mo bcu yi bdag nyid can/ /rlung sogs rim pas dmangs rigs mo/ /rgyal rigs de bzhin bram ze mo/ /rje mo gdol mo nya pa mo/ /gar ma de bzhin tshos mkhan ma/ /ko lpags byed ma gtum mo ni/ /mthar skyes chos khams ma ste bcu/ /rig ma chen mor yang dag brjod/ /longs spyod grol 'bras rab tu ster/ /gzhan yang sum cu rtsa drug rigs/ /rnal 'byor ma brgya'i rigs byung ba/ /mi 'gyur bde chen sgrub pa'i phyir/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ / mahā bidyai mū drā/ kunda rab tu khyab byed dri bzang dang*/ /rnam dag nyi mas dag byed me tog phreng*/ /don dam dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /'gro bas rnam dag zla ni thob par shog /gtum mo 'bar bas kun rtog bsregs pa'i spos/ / snying nang gzhom med 'bar ba'i snang gsal tshogs/ /don dam dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /spros bral ye shes snang ba thob par shog /'dod yon gzhan mchog bdud rtsi zhal zas lnga/ /thig le nor bur bcings pa'i ma nyams 'bru/ don dam dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /stong pa'i gzugs kyis byang sems 'ching bar shog /ma dag gnas gyur ye shes sgeg mo'i lus/ /lus rlung dhū tīr thim pa bzhad sgra'i dbyangs/ /don dam dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /rdo rje'i sku dang bcu gnyis sa thob shog /gzhol med nā da'i rol mo sil snyan mchog /rnam gsum phyag rgya'i rol pa bde ba'i gar/ /don dam dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ grags stong sgra dang sgyu rtsal mchog thob shog
/sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho chos nyid rdo rje'i glu/ /mi 'gyur bde sgrub phyag chen 'dod pa mo/ /don dam dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /
