rdo rje'i gsung dang mi 'gyur bde thob shog / ces mchod pa bcu gnyis kyi nges don dran pas mchod pa'o// de nas bstod pa ni/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ / nas/ ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ / kyi bar 'dud nyi shu dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo bde chen po/ /sku gsum mchog dang dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje gsum mchog rdo rje dbyangs/ / 'gyur ba med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam rtog sgom pa las 'das pa/ /phyag rgya chen po mi 'gyur bde/ /gzugs dang 'dzin pa dbyibs dag dang*/ /rtog dang dpyod pa rnam par spangs/ /dri za'i grong khyer rnam pa dang*/ /pra phab pa y-i rang bzhin can/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid sbyor/ /e waṃ yi ge de la 'dud/ / sangs rgyas kun gyi bskyed mdzad ma/ /skye ba dang ni 'jig pa spangs/ /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa can/ /sna tshogs yum de la phyag 'tshal/ /ā li kā li snyoms 'jug dang*/ /hūṃ phaṭa yi ge sogs spangs kyang*/ /'gyur ba med las 'khrungs pa'i sku/ /dus kyi 'khor lo de la 'dud/ /kun mkhyen ye shes sku zhes pa/ khyab bdag nyi ma lta bu'i sku/ /padma'i 'dab ma rgyas pa'i spyan/ /de nyid bcu drug dbye ba las/ /sku bzhi'i bdag nyid sangs rgyas ni/ /rdo rje seng ge'i gdan bzhugs pa/ /lha dang lha min gyis bstod sngon/ /zla bzang gis gsol de la 'dud/ / rnam par bcas kyang rnam med bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab ma ste de yis 'khyud/ /skye 'jig spangs pa'i 'gyur med bde ba dang ldan dgod pa la sogs bde ba spangs/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi bskyed mdzad sku gsum rnams dang ldan zhing dus gsum yang dag rig /kun mkhyen mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan gnyis med de nyid la phyag 'tshal/ /gang la thog mtha' dbus med gnas dang zhes pa nas/ mchog gi bha ga khyod la 'dud de khyod la 'dud/ / ces pas bstod/ gzhan yang spro zhing nus na chos rje kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa'i bstod chen dang*/

'grel chen dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi le'u so so dang*/ mdor bsdus so so'i thog mar 'byung ba'i tshigs bcad rnams kyis kyang bstod par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i gnas skabs su/ /sbyin bsreg byed pa po logs na yod na des sbyin bsreg bya zhing*/ med na slob dpon gyis skabs 'dir rgyas pa'i sbyin bsreg bya'o/ /de'i rjes su dkyil 'khor bsrung ba po zhig bzhag la/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyir rol tu song nas gtor ma gtong ste/ de yang gtor ma drug gam bdun mchod pa dang bcas pa bshams/ byin gyis brlabs nas/ bsrung ma drug cu dang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs la gtor chog bzhin phul/ sde drug bsrung ma drug cu dang*/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams dang*/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par mdzod la/ bdag cag dkyil 'khor gyi las la zhugs pa rnams kyi yid la bsams pa'i don thams cad sgrub pa dang*/ bar chad thams cad las bsrung ba dang bskyab pa dang sbed pa dang*/ dngos grub kyi sdong grogs dam pa mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'phrin las bcol la/ oṃ hriḥbi shuddha 'i sngags kyis 'thor 'thung 'gro phyogs su sgrengs/ gtor ma rnams phyogs so sor gshegs su gsol/ sarba duṣtan gatstsha zhes pa'am/ drag sngags bzla zhing tsham rngams dang bcas pas bgegs rnams bskrad la/ nang mchod dam dri chus reg ste/ y-i ge drug pas gnas drug byin gyis brlabs/ slob dpon gyis rt-ing mnan la nang du 'ong*/ nye reg byas la bdag 'jug la sogs pa'i las la 'jug go /sgo dbye ba dang me tog 'bul ba la sogs pa ni 'dir mi bzhed do/ /lnga pa ni/ slob ma dbang bskur ba'i don du ni nges par bdag 'jug dgos pa ma yin zhing*/ de'i phyir phyogs 'di'i rgyud 'grel nas gsal bar ma gsungs la/ 'on te bsod nams 'phel ba'i don du lugs gzhan dang bstun te byed pa yang*/

bla ma dam pa'i man ngag ste tshad ldan kho na'o// de yang slob ma la ji ltar bskur ba ltar gyi cho ga mtha' dag blang ba dang*/ cho ga'i gtso bo rnams blang ba dang*/ sngags dbang tsam blangs kyang rung ste/ rgyas pa dang 'bring po dang bsdus pa'i rim pa'o/ /de nas dbu rgyan la sogs pa'i dbang rdzas rnams mdun du bzhag dung chos kyi chu cung zad btung la khrus byas te/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis na/ / sogs shlau ka gcig dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ maṇḍal ni/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /gu ru ratna sogs brjod/ de nas/ mi zad 'khor bas 'jigs pa bdag ni de ring nyid nas rgyal ba rnams la skyabs su lhag par mchi/ khyod kyi zhabs kyi chu skyes nges par srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog dag la lus ngag sems ni dag pas so/ / zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas/ 'dod pa'i rdo rje la ni rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya bla ma dag kyang spyi bos bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen la ni sbyin pa sbyin bgyi 'khor lo 'di la rgyal ba mchog gi dam tshig bskyang bar bgyi/ /ral gri la ni mchod pa bgyi ste gsal bar chu skyes rigs la sdom pa rnams ni bskyang bar bgyi/ /sems can rnams ni thar pa'i slad du rgyal ba bskyed mdzad rigs la byang chub bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ / zhes lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ kṣaḥ badzra dan ta kāṣṭha <rdo rje so shing > tsa tur bi mo kṣa mu kha <rnam par thar ba'i sgo bzhi > bi shud dha swa bhā waṃ <rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin > kā ya wāka tsitta dzñā na <sku gsung thugs ye shes > mu kha dan ta ā dī ma laṃ <kha dang so la sogs pa dri ma > bi sho dha ya bi shodha ya hūṃ/ <rnam par sbyongs rnam par sbyongs/> so shing dor/

dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ/ mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la āḥ snying gar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la hūṃ/ lte bar dus me'i dkyil 'khor la hoḥ gtsug tor du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la haṃ/ gsang bar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la kṣaḥ oṃ hrīḥbi shuddha sarba dhārma sarba pā pāṃ niñtsa a sya sho dha ya sarba bi kalpān a pa na ya hūṃ/ khyor chu btung*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bdud rtsi lce la reg dga' ba la dga' khyod su kye/ /bde chen bdag ni skal ba bzang*/ / de nas/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta uta pā ta yā miḥ zhes brjod cing sems bskyed la/ me tog dang bcas pa'i rdo rje snying gar bzung ste/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ hoḥsiddha badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ rdo rje spyi bor bzung nas/ deng khyod la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlob par 'gyur gyis/ khyod kyis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsung pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya zhing*/ ma dad par yang mi bya'o/ / zhes brjod nas/ oṃ āḥya mān ta kṛta hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing khrid de/ āḥkhaṃ bī ra hūṃ/ zhes pas yol ba'i nang du bcug nas bsams la/ mahā ra ta su dṛ dha su to ṣyo su su kho badzra satwā adhya sidhya māṃ/ zhes 'don zhing bskor ba byed par mos/ thal mo sbyar bas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dzo pa sthā nā ya āta mā naṃ niryā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra satwa a dhi tiṣṭha māṃ/ zhes pa dang*/ yang de nyid las/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza karma ṇi/ ātmā naṃ niryā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra karma ku ru māṃ/ zhes pa dang*/ lhor/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta pū dza a bhi ṣe kā ya ātmā naṃ niryā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ zhes pa dang*/ nub tu/ oṃ sarba buddhā pū dzo pasthā nā ya ātmā naṃ niryā ta yā mi/

sarba ta thā ga ta badzra bai ro tsa na a dhi tiṣṭha māṃ/ zhes pa dang*/ byang du/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra warta nā ya ātmā naṃ niryā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra dharma pra brta yā mi/ oṃ gu ru tsa ra ṇo pasthā nā ya ātmā naṃ niryā mi/ oṃ sarba satwa pa rī trā ṇārthā ya ātmā naṃ niryā ta yā mi/ zhes bla ma la phyag 'tshal bar bya ste/ phyogs rnams su yod par mos pa tsam bya zhing*/ phyag kyang yid kyis bya'o/ /de nas spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bas na ngas khyod la rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis 'di dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ mgo bor rdo rje bzung nas dril bu dkrol zhing*/ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste/ khyod kyi dam tshig rdo rje 'di'o/ /gal te khyod kyis 'ga' zhig la/ /'di smras na ni mgo bo 'gems/ / rdo rje snying gar bzung ste/ oṃ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang*/ khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ / dung gi chu btung zhing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig srung na dngos grub ste/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung zhig /oṃ badzra a mṛ ta u ta ra ka ṭhaḥ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi rdo rje 'chang nga yin gyis/ ngas 'di gyis shig ces bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so/ khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang mi bya ste/ khyod yang ba ma spangs par tshe'i dus byas nas sems can dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ de nas ye shes dbab pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag nyid khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs/

zhabs gnyis pa/ mgrin pa gsum pa/ zhal bzhi pa/ phrag pa drug pa/ dpung pa bcu gnyis pa/ phyag gi padma nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ lhag pa'i phyag gnyis te nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ mtshon cha rnams dang phyag rgya lnga dang klu'i dbang po'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan pa'i skur gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la 'bab par gyur cig / ces lan gsum brjod la/ rang gi snying gar laṃ las skyes pa'i sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa rdo rjes mtshan par nyi ma la hūṃ sngon po dang*/ mgo bor waṃ las byung ba'i chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan par zla ba la haḥdakar po dang*/ mgrin par yaṃ las byung ba'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu lta bu ba dan g.yo ba gnyis kyis mtshan par zla ba la āḥdamar po dang*/ rkang pa dag gi 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi shugs kyis sbar bzhin pa/ raṃ las byung ba'i me'i dkyil dmar po raṃ gyis mtshan pa 'od zer 'phro ba la gnas pa'i dzhaiḥdamar pos bdag nyid 'degs bzhin par gyur/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer mtha' yas pa 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje rnams hūṃ haḥ.āḥrnams la thim zhing*/ rkang pa'i bu ga nas dzhaiḥ'i 'od zer gyi tshogs zhugs pa dang*/ hūṃ la sogs pa'i 'od zer rnams kyis lus kyi nang mtha' dag gang bar gyur/ sngar bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma lnga'i spos kyi dud pas bdug cing*/ dril bu dkrol ba dang bcas pas/ oṃ a ra ra ra ra la la la la badzra ā bhe sha ya hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes mgo la me tog dor/ dpral par oṃ/ snying gar hūṃ/ gtsug tor du haṃ/ mgrin par āḥ lte bar hoḥ gsang bar kṣaḥrnams su gyur/ 'tshe dang mi bden gzhan gyi bud med spang bya gzhan gyi nor dang chang gi btung ba de bzhin nyid/

/'khor bar rdo rje'i zhags pa dag ste rang gi dge ba 'joms byed sdig pa lnga po 'di rnams so/ /gang zhig gang gi dus su byung ba lha dang mi yi bla ma de yi mtshan gyis rab sbyin bya/ /sna tshogs gtso bo'i bka' 'di srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms pa dag ste khyod kyis kyang ni bskyang bar bya/ /cho lo kha na ma tho bcas pa'i zas dang tshig ngan klog dang 'byung po lha min dbang po'i chos/ /ba lang byis pa bud med skyes pa rnams dang lha mi'i bla ma gsod pa lnga ni mi bya'o/ / grogs po rje bo rnams dang lha dang mi yi bla ma dge 'dun yid brtan rnams la 'khu ba yang*/ /dbang po rnams ni kun nas chags pa dag ste de ltar srid pa'i bdag po'i brtul zhugs nyi shu lnga/ / zhes bsgrags la/ srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /brtul zhugs nyi shu rtsa lnga po/ /sna tshogs gtso bo'i gsung ji bzhin/ /bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ / zhes lan gsum gyis bzung*/ de nas/ oṃ dwā da sha aṃ ga ni ro dha kā ri ṇe hūṃ phaṭa/ ces gdongs bcings/ gos ser po bsgos par mos/ dkyil 'khor la lan gsum bskor ba byas par mos te/ sngar brjod pa'i mahā ra ta sogs/ oṃ āḥhūṃḥhoḥhaṃ kṣaḥ zhes shar sgor dung gi chus mgo la bsang gtor byas nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes pa lan bdun gyis bsngags pa'i me tog byin par mos/ de nas/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha rnams rigs kyi rim pa ni/ /bsod nams ci 'dra de 'drar shog /de yi dngos grub ci 'drar 'gyur/ /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /bsod nams mthu yang gang 'dra ba// de 'dra dkyil 'khor du gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ku la bi sho dha ni swāhā/ zhes pa 'dis me tog dor/ oṃ pra ti gṛ hna twaṃ i maṃ sa twaṃ mahā ba la/ me tog mgo bor bcing ngo*// de nas/ dpral bar raṃ/ mig gnyis la 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i oṃ oṃ/

oṃ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang*/ khyod kyi mig ni 'byed par brtson/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla med pa/ /thams cad mig ni 'byed par mdzad/ /oṃ de byen tri yā ṇyā ṭa ghā ṭa swāhā/ oṃ di bya ya na mud ghā ṭa yā mi swāhā/ zhes mig dar dgrol/ da ni dad pa'i shugs kyis su/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /phyag rgya sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs/ /dngos grub kun ni phun sum tshogs/ /dam tshig mchog tu khyod 'gyur gyis/ /rdo rje padma mchog rol pas/ /gsang sngags rnams la sgrub par gyis/ /rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum du mthong bar gyur/ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor chen por bdag zhugs so/ /rnam 'byor dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor chen po bdag gis mthong*/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor chen por bdag dbang bskur/ /hoḥhoḥhoḥ zhes brjod par byas te/ dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa'i cho ga'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rjes deng bdag stsol/ /

zhes spyi khyab tu lan gsum gsol ba btab/ oṃ swa bhā wa= stong pa'i ngang las u yig dang padma las rang nyid sku rdo rje 'od dpag med du gyur/ slob dpon gyi phyag g.yas pa'i rdo rjes khrid de/ dkyil 'khor la mngon du phyogs pas bskor ba byas te byang gi sgo'i sa la gnas par gyur/ chu dang cod pan gyi dbang gi don du maṇḍal 'bul/ chu dbang gi don du/ oṃ haṃ hāṃ hiṃ hīṃ huṃ hūṃ hl̥ṃ hl̥̄ṃ <dbang gi rdzas bum pa bcu'i sa bon > ā ī ṝ ū l̥̄ <dbang gi lha yum lnga'i sa bon > badzra ḍā ki ṇyo <rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams > badzra a mṛ ta gha ṭai ra a bhi ṣiñtsa na tu māṃ swāhā/ <rdo rje bdud rtsi'i bum pa rnams kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol ba dag la/> zhes lan gsum/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rgyal ba yab yum/ byang chub sems dpa' dang lha mo/ khro bo'i rgyal po dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ nam mkha' gang ba'i sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ gandhaṃ sogs mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ oṃ badzra dhā twī shwa ri huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swāhā/ oṃ paṇḍar bā si ni ba ra de swāhā/ oṃ mā ma kī ki ri ki ri swāhā/ oṃ lo tsa na ba su de swāhā/ zhes bum pa so so nas chu bsdus te dung chos su blug swa bhā wa= stong pa'i ngang las ā las byung ba'i steng dang 'og gi bum chu rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i ngo bo/ ī las byung ba'i shar dang me'i bum chu sgron ma'i ngo bo/ ṝ las byung ba'i lho dang bden bral gyi bum chu gos dkar mo'i ngo bo/ ū las byung ba'i byang dang dbang ldan gyi bum chu mā ma kī'i ngo bo/ l̥̄ las byung ba'i nub dang rlung gi bum chu spyan ma rnams kyi ngo bo gyur/

gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad bum chu ye shes pa'i rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ dung gi chu bteg cing me tog gtor la/ oṃ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste/ /des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas padma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /des ni de ring khyod la zhi byed bkra shis shog /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye rgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /des ni de ring khyod la zhi byed bkra shis shog /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /des ni de ring khyod la zhi byed bkra shis shog /oṃ ā ī ṝ ū l̥̄ pañtsa dhā tu bi sho dha ni swāhā/ <khams lnga rnam par sbyongs/> zhes pas skye ba'i gnas lngar dbang bskur/ de ltar chu'i dbang bskur bas khams lnga rnam par dag pa yum lngar gyur pa ni/ gtsug tor du mkha' khams rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ dpral par rlung khams sgrol ma/ mgrin par me khams gos dkar mo/ snying gar chu khams mā ma kī/ lte bar sa khams sangs rgyas spyan ma rnams su gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad yum lnga'i rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ de ltar na yum lnga'i sgo nas chu'i dbang bskur ba thob/ rlung la sogs pa'i khams lnga rnam par dag cing sgrib pa dang bral/

de bzhin gshegs ma rnams byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ de nas cod pan gyi dbang gi don du/ oṃ aṃ iṃ ṛṃ uṃ l̥+-iṃ <phung po gzhan lnga'i sa bon > sarba buddha <sangs rgyas thams cad > badzra mu ku ṭaṃ ma ma <rdo rje cod pan bdag la > pañtsa buddha <sangs rgyas lnga'i > ātma kaṃ bandha yan tu huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ <bdag nyid can bcing du gsol/> ces lan gsum/ swa bha wa= stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i cod pan ljang khu mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo/ e las byung ba'i cod pan nag po don yod grub pa'i ngo bo/ ṛ las byung ba'i cod pan dmar po rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngo bo/ u las byung ba'i cod pan dkar po 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo/ li las byung ba'i cod pan ser po rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bor gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa rnams/ cod pan ye shes pa'i rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ a a ṛ u l̥ pañtsa ta thā ga ta pa ri shuddha swāhā/ <de bzhin gshegs pa lnga yongs su dag pa/> zhes dung gi chus gong bzhin dang*/ dbu rgyan gnas lngar gtugs te mgo la bcings/ cod pan gyi dbang bskur bas phung po lnga rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas lngar gyur pa ni lte bar gzugs phung rnam par snang mdzad/ dpral bar 'du shes snang ba mtha' yas/ mgrin par tshor ba rin chen 'byung ldan/ snying khar 'du byed don yod grub pa/ gtsug tor du rnam shes mi bskyod pa rnams su gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ de ltar na sangs rgyas lnga'i sgo nas cod pan gyi dbang bskur ba thob/ phung po lnga rnam par dag cing sgrib pa dang bral bar gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs par gyur/

dbang de gnyis kyi thun mong gi dag pa ni/ tshul de lta bus byang sgor sku'i zhal gyis la chu dang cod pan gyi dbang bskur ba thob pas/ sku rdo rje dri ma dang bral bar gyur/ swa bhā wa= stong pa'i ngang las/ āḥyig dang padma las rang nyid gsung rdo rje rin chen 'byung ldan du gyur/ slob dpon gyi phyag g.yas pa'i rdo rjes khrid de/ dkyil 'khor la mngon du phyogs pas bskor ba byas te lho'i sgor gnas par gyur/ dar dpyangs dang dril bu'i dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul la/ dar dpyangs kyi dbang gi don du/ oṃ a ā aṃ aḥha hā haṃ haḥphreṃ hoḥ <nus ma bcu'i sa bon > sarba pā ra mi tā ma ma badzra paṭṭaṃ bandha yan tu huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ <pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad bdag la rdo rje dar dpyangs bcing du gsol/> ces lan gsum/ swa bhā wa= stong pa'i ngang las/ a dang ha las byung ba'i dar dpyangs nag po gnyis nag mo'i 'bar ma dang du ba ma'i ngo bo/ aḥdang haḥlas byung ba'i dar dpyangs dmar po gnyis dmar mo 'bar ma dang smig rgyu ma'i ngo bo/ aṃ dang haṃ las byung ba'i dar dpyangs dkar po gnyis dkar mo 'bar ma dang mkha' snang ma'i ngo bo/ ā dang hā las byung ba'i dar dpyangs ser po gnyis ser mo 'bar ma dang mar me ma'i ngo bo/ phreṃ dang hoḥlas byung ba'i dar dpyangs ljang khu dang sngon po gnyis mchog gi cha ma dang*/ thig le ma'i ngo bor gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad dar dpyangs ye shes pa'i rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ a ā aṃ aḥ ha hā haṃ ha phreṃ hoḥd sha pā ra mi tā pa ri pū ra ṇi swāhā/ <pha rol tu phyin pa bcu yongs su rdzogs pa/> dung gi chu gong bzhin dang*/ dar dpyangs gnas lngar reg nas mgo la bcings/ dar dpyangs kyi dbang bskur bas/ rlung bcu rnam par dag pa nus ma bcur gyur pa ni/ snying ga'i shar du mnyam gnas kyi rlung nag mo 'bar ma/

lhor gyen rgyu'i rlung dmar mo 'bar ma/ byang du khyab byed kyi rlung dkar mo 'bar ma/ nub tu klu'i rlung ser mo 'bar ma/ shar lhor rus sbal gyi rlung du ba ma/ lho nub tu rtsangs pa'i rlung smig rgyu ma/ byang shar du lhas byin gyi rlung mkha' snang ma/ nub byang du nor las rgyal gyi rlung mar me ma/ steng du srog 'dzin gyi rlung mchog gi cha ma/ 'og tu thur sel gyi rlung thig le ma rnams su gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad nus ma bcu'i rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ de ltar nus ma bcu'i sgo nas dar dpyangs kyi dbang bskur ba thob/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu rnam par dag cing sgrib pa dang bral/ nus ma rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ de nas rdo rje dril bu'i dbang gi don du/ oṃ hūṃ hoḥ <gtso bo yab yum kyi sa bon/> bi dzñā na <rnam shes > dzñā na swa bhā we/ <ye shes kyi rang bzhin can > ka ru ṇa pradzñā ād ma ke <snying rje dang shes rab kyi bdag nyid can > badzraṃ badzra ghan ṭe <rdo rje dang rdo rje'i dril bu > sa bye ta ra ka ra yor <g.yas dang g.yon gyi lag pa dag tu > ma ma badzra satwa <bdag la rdo rje sems dpa' > saṃ pradzñāo da dāṃ tu huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ <shes rab dang bcas bstsal du gsol/> ces lan gsum/ swa bhā wa= stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje dus kyi 'khor lo'i ngo bo dang*/ hoḥlas byung ba'i rdo rje'i dril bu sna tshogs yum gyi ngo bor gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad rdo rje dang rdo rje'i dril bu ye shes pa'i rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ hūṃ hoḥsūrya tsand+ra bi sho dha ka swāhā/ <nyi ma zla ba rnam par sbyongs/> dung gi chu sngon du 'gro bas/

rdo rje dril bu spyi bor bzhag cing lag tu sbyin/ rdo rje dang rdo rje'i dril bu'i dbang bskur bas/ rtsa ro ma dang rkyang ma rnam par dag pa gtso bo yab yum du gyur pa ni/ rkyang ma dus kyi 'khor lo dang*/ ro ma sna tshogs yum mnyam par sbyor ba lte ba'i dkyil 'khor du bzhugs par gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad dus kyi 'khor lo dang*/ sna tshogs yum gyi rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ de ltar na gtso bo yab yum gyi sgo nas/ rdo rje dang dril bu'i dbang bskur ba thob/ zla ba dang nyi ma'i rtsa la la nā dang*/ ras nā rnam par dag cing sgrib pa dang bral/ gtso bo yab yum gyis byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ tshul de lta bus lho sgor gsung gi zhal gyi sa la dar dpyangs dang dril bu'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ gsung rdo rje rnam par dag cing dri ma dang bral bar gyur/ swa bhā wa= stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ las rang nyid thugs rdo rje don yod grub par gyur/ slob dpon gyi phyag g.yas pa'i rdo rjes khrid de/ dky-il 'khor la mngon du phyogs pas bskor ba byas te/ shar sgo'i sa la gnas par gyur/ brtul zhugs dang ming dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul la/ rdo rje brtul zhugs kyi dbang gi don du/ oṃ a ā e ai ar ār o au al āl aṃ aḥ <skye mched bcu gnyis kyi sa bon/> sarba bo dhi satwāḥ <byang chub sems dpa' thams cad > sa bhāryaḥ <btsun mo dang bcas pa rnams > sarba dā <thams cad kyi tshe > sarba kā ma <'dod pa thams cad > u pa bho gaṃ <nye bar longs spyod pa > badzra pra ti <rdo rje brtul zhugs > ma ma da dāṃ tu swāhā/ <bdag la stsal tu gsol/> zhes lan gsum/ swa bhā wa= stong pa'i ngang las/ a ā las me tog sil ma ljang khu phyag rdor dang chos dbyings rdo rje ma'i ngo bo/ e ai las me tog nag po nam mkha'i snying po dang reg bya rdo rje ma'i ngo bo/

ar ār las me tog dmar pos snying dang ro rdo rje ma'i ngo bo/ o au las me tog dkar po 'jig rten dbang phyug dang gzugs rdo rje ma'i ngo bo/ al āl las me tog ser po sgrib pa rnam sel dang dri rdo rje ma'i ngo bo/ aṃ aḥlas me tog sil ma sngon po kun bzang dang sgra rdo rje ma'i ngo bor gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad me tog sil ma ye shes pa'i rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ a ā e ai ar ār o au al āl aṃ aḥ bi ṣa ya ind+ra ya bi sho dha ni swāhā <yul dang dbang po rnam par sbyongs/> dung gi chu sngon du 'gro bas/ me tog rna ba'i ltag la sogs par 'god do/ / brtul zhugs kyi dbang bskur bas/ dbang po drug yul dang bcas pa rnam par dag pa sems dpa' yab yum bcu gnyis su gyur pa ni/ rna ba gnyis su rna ba'i dbang po phyag na rdo rje dang*/ yul sgra sgra rdo rje ma/ sna bug gnyis su sna'i dbang po nam mkha'i snying po dang*/ yul dri dri rdo rje ma/ mig gnyis su mig gi dbang po sa'i snying po dang*/ yul gzugs gzugs rdo rje ma/ lce'i rtsa bar lce'i dbang po 'jig rten dbang phyug dang*/ yul ro ro rdo rje ma/ gsang ba'i rtsa bar lus kyi dbang po sgrib pa rnam sel dang*/ yul reg bya reg bya rdo rje ma/ snying khar yid kyi dbang po kun tu bzang po dang*/ yul chos chos khams rdo rje ma rnams su gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad sems dpa' yab yum bcu gnyis kyi rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ de ltar na sems dpa' yab yum gyi sgo nas/ brtul zhugs kyi dbang bskur ba thob pas/ dbang po drug yul dang bcas pa rnam par dag cing sgrib pa dang bral bar gyur/

sems dpa' yab yum rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ de nas ming dbang gi don du/ oṃ ha hā ya yā ra rā wa wā la lā/ <khro bo yab yum gyi sa bon/> sarba kro dha rā dzāḥ <khro bo'i rgyal po thams cad > sa bhāryā <btsun mo dang bcas pa > me trī ka ru ṇā' <byams dang snying rje > mu di ta <dga' ba > u be kṣā <btang snyoms > sarba sa ma tā <thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi > swa bhā waṃ <rang bzhin > badzra pūrbaṃ ga maṃ nā <rdo rje sngon du 'gro ba'i ming > ma me da dān tu huṃ hūṃ phaṭa <bdag la stsal du gsol/> zhes lan gsum/ swa bhā wa= stong pa'i ngang las/ ha hā las byung ba'i gdu bu'am me tog 'phreng ba ljang khu dang sngon po gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba dang drag spyan ma'i ngo bo/ ya yā las byung ba'i gdu bu'am me tog 'phreng ba nag po bgegs mthar byed dang shin tu brtson 'grus ma 'i ngo bo/ ra rā las byung ba'i gdu bu'am me tog 'phreng ba dmar po shes rab mthar byed dang rmugs byed ma'i ngo bo/ wa wā las byung ba'i gdu bu'am me tog 'phreng ba dkar po padma mthar byed dang khengs byed ma 'i ngo bo/ la lā las byung ba'i gdu bu'am me tog 'phreng ba ser po gshin rje mthar byed dang rengs byed ma'i ngo bo gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad lag gdub rkang gdub bam/ me tog 'phreng ba ye shes pa'i rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ ha hā ya yā ra rā wa wā la lā tsa tūrp+ra hma bi hā ra bi shuddha swāhā/

<tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi rnam par dag pa/> dung gi chu sngon du 'gro bas/ gdu bu rnams yan lag la bcing ngo*/ /gdu bu med na me tog phreng bas rung ngo*/ / kye dpal <mi bskyod rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o//> 'di zhes bya'o/ /zhes ming btags pa dran par byas te/ kye chgai mo <dpal mi bskyod > rdo rje na maḥ ta thā ga ta siddhi sa ma ya st+waṃ bhur bhū baḥswa/ ming gi dbang bskur bas/ las dbang bya ba dang bcas pa rnam par dag pa khro bo yab yum du gyur pa ni/ mgo bo dang gtsug tor du gsang ba'i dbang po dang mchog gi dbang po/ khro bo gtsug tor can dang*/ bya ba dri chu dang khu ba 'dor ba gsang gnas su khro mo drag spyan ma/ kha la ngag gi dbang po bgegs mthar byed dang*/ bya ba smra ba rengs byed ma/ lag pa la lag pa'i dbang po shes rab mthar byed dang*/ bya ba len pa rmugs byed ma/ rkang pa la rkang pa'i dbang po padma mthar byed dang*/ bya ba 'gro ba khengs byed ma/ bshang lam du bshang lam gyi dbang po gshin rje mthar byed dang*/ bya ba bshang ba 'dor ba shin tu brtson 'grus ma rnams su gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad khro bo yab yum bcu'i rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ de ltar na khro bo yab yum gyi sgo nas ming gi dbang bskur ba thob/ 'dod chags la sogs pa nyon mongs pa bzhi dag tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi thob/ las dbang yul dang bcas pa rnam par dag cing sgrib pa dang bral bar gyur/ khro bo yab yum rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ tshul de lta bus shar sgor thugs kyi zhal gyi sa la brtul zhugs dang ming gi dbang bskur ba thob pas/ thugs rdo rje rnam par dag cing dri ma dang bral bar gyur/ swa bhā wa= stong pa'i ngang las/ hoḥlas byung ba'i rang nyid ye shes rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad du gyur/

slob dpon gyi phyag g.yas pa'i rdo rjes khrid de/ dkyil 'khor la mngon du phyogs pas bskor ba byas te/ nub sgo'i sa la gnas par gyur/ rjes gnang gi dbang zhu ba'i don du maṇḍal 'bul/ oṃ e waṃ <rdo rje sems dpa'i sa bon/> padma badzra tsi hṇau <padma rdo rje mtshan ma dag > pradzñā u pā yau <shes rab thabs dag > maṇḍal <dkyil 'khor gyi > a dhi pa tī <mnga' bdag > badzra su kha dzñā na aṃ ga ma ma da dā tāṃ haṃ haḥhūṃ phaṭa/ <rdo rje bde ba ye shes kyi yan lag sku bdag la stsal tu gsol/> zhes lan gsum/ swa bhā wa= stong pa'i ngang las haṃ dang kṣaḥlas byung ba'i 'khor lo la sogs pa phyag mtshan rdo rje sems dpa' dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i ngo bor gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad phyag mtshan ye shes pa'i rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ haṃ kṣaḥ dharma tsakra pra brta ka swāhā/ <chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor bar byed pa/> dung gi chu sngon du 'gro bas 'khor lo bzung la/ 'jig rten kun la thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ rgyas pa la spro na/ chos kyi zhes pa'i gnas su/ padma/ rin chen/ ral gri/ rdo rje zhes pa rnams bcug nas/ slob ma la phyag mtshan rnams kyis rim pas dbang bskur ba yin kyang*/ bdag 'jug la 'khor lo gcig pus chog cing*/ slob ma dbang bskur ba la yang ngo*/ /rjes gnang gi dbang bskur bas/ ye shes kyi khams dang ye shes kyi phung po rnam par dag pa rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du gyur pa ni/ gsang bar ye shes kyi phung po rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ ye shes kyi khams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin mar gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par badzra sa ma dzaḥ

dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ de ltar na rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi sgo nas rjes gnang gi dbang bskur ba thob pas/ ye shes kyi phung khams rnam par dag cing sgrib pa dang bral/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyis byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ oṃ badzra he tu maṃ bhruṃ las byung ba'i 'khor lo/ oṃ badzra bha ṣā raṃ aḥlas byung ba'i dung*/ a las byung ba'i po ti/ aḥlas byung ba'i dril bu/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ / nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor bas/ / thams cad mchog gi mnyam nyid gsal/ /deng nas brtsams te dam bcas pa'i/ /sems ni bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /de ring phan chad 'jig rten la/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /kun nas yongs su bkang nas ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bgyi/ /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin bdag /yid bzhin nor bu ltar mthong bas/ /skyon med dogs dang bral ba yi/ /de ltar sems can don gyis shig /tshul de lta bus nub sgor ye shes kyi zhal gyi sa la rjes su gnang ba yan lag dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar nus zhing*/ ye shes rdo rje dri ma dang bral bar gyur/ rim pa de ltar dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bdun gyis mngon par dbang bskur ba thob pas/ sngags kyi tshul la dge bsnyen du gyur zh-ing*/ sa bdun gyi dbang phyug tu lung bstan pa thob pas sangs rgyas kyi rigs su skyes par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta <de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi > sapta a bhi she ka <bdun gyis mngon par dbang bskur ba > sapta bhū mi pra ptohaṃ <sa bdun thob pa nga*/> rdo rje lag pa g.yas kyis gsor la snying gar bzung nas/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o/

/ dril bu lag pa g.yon pas 'khrol zhing dku g.yon par brten/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung*/ /āḥ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyi dag /ngo bo nyid kyi srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /nges par rdo rje'i rigs dag la ni srog gcod bya ste ral gri la yang bden pa min pa'i tshig /rin chen la ni gzhan nor dbrog bya mchog gi padma'i rigs nyid la yang gzhan gyi bud med dbrog /chang dang sgron ma sangs rgyas rnams dang bzang po'i yul rnams mtha' dag 'khor lo la ni bsten par bya/ /g.yung mo la sogs mtha' dag bud med rnams ni gri gug la yang mkha' yi padmar smad mi bya/ / sems can don gyi slad du nor dang bcas pa'i lus 'di sbyin par bya ste khyod kyis srung mi bya/ /rigs kyi bu kye sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ba gzhan du mtha' yas bskal pas min par rgyal bas gsungs/ / zhes brjod/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba spang bar gdams pa yang brjod par bya ste/ gal te g.yo sgyus dbang gis rtsa ba'i ltung ba byung na dmyal bar 'gro ste 'di dag sdug bsngal lo/ / zhes dang*/ dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs dkrugs pa las bu rnams kyi ni rtsa ba'i ltung ba ri bong 'dzin par 'gyur// de yi bka' la dgongs pas gzhan du 'gyur te nges par de bzhin spun la khros pas gsum pa'o/ /byams pa btang bas bzhi par 'gyur te byang chub sems ni rab tu nyams pa las kyang mda' ru 'gyur/ /drug pa grub pa'i mtha' la smod pa ri bo dag kyang ma smin mi la gsang ba byin las so/ /phung po nyon mongs pa las klu ru 'gyur te slar yang dgu pa dag pa'i chos la ma dad gang*/ /sgyu yi byams pa dang ni ming sogs bral ba bde ba ster la rtogs pa phyogs dang drag po'o/ /dag pa'i sems can dag la skyon brjod pa las nyi ma dam tshig thob pa gtong ba las kyang gzhan/

/bud med thams cad la smod nges par ma nur 'gyur te rdo rje theg par gnas pa rnams la'o/ / zhes pas so/ /'di ni bdag 'jug skabs bsdus pa la dga' ba'i tshe ma brjod kyang chog la/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i tshe ni nges par brjod dgos so/ / de ltar na rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun bskur bas/ sngags bzlas pa dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sgom pa la dbang bar 'gyur te/ 'og min gyi srid pa'i mthar thug par 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi bden pa nyid kyis bsod nams dang ye shes kyi 'bras bu thob pa'i slad du bdag gis lung bstan zhing rjes su gnang ngo*//srid pa'i ngan 'gro las bton nas/ /srid pa shin tu zhi bya'i phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bdag gis khyod ni lung bstan bgyi/ /kyai khyod ni <dpal mi bskyod > rdo rje chgai mo / ta thā ga ta shi ṣyā sa ma ya st+waṃ bhur bhu baḥswa/ gang yang 'di ltar lung bstan pa de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston to/ / de dag ni byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang gi cho ga'o/ /mdor bsdus rgyud 'di nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa la kha skong dang bral ba'i lugs byed na/ dri ba dris lan nas/ dam bzhag rdzogs kyi bar dang*/ bden pa'i byin rlabs brjod pa dang*/ mig dar dgrol pa'i tshigs bcad/ lta ba bskul ba/ ched du brjod pa/ dbang spyi'i gsol btab/ rjes gnang gi phyag mtshan phyi ma rnams dang*/ chos bshad kyi rjes gnang dang rdo rje dang dril bu'i dam tshig sbyin pa'i dmigs pa dang*/ tshigs bcad dang*/ lung bstan rnams dkyil chog gzhan gyi lugs las kha bskang bar snang bas/ bsdus pa la dga' ba'am yid ches na de rnams bor pas chog go / de nas dbang gong ma rnams zhu ba'i don du rig ma mchog dang maṇḍal phul te/ sgrib pa thams cad bcom pa yi/

/dus kyi 'khor lo khyod la 'dud/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur bdes gang ba/ /ye shes sku khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ /byang chub sems ni 'gyur med gang*/ /dbang bskur de yis bdag la ni// mgon po da ni bka' drin mdzod/ /bu dang chung ma sogs bcas pa/ /bdag ni dus kun khyod kyi 'bangs/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i mthar/ /bdag la skyabs gzhan yod ma yin/ /zhes pas thun mong du gsol ba btab nas/ khyad par bum pa'i dbang bskur bar gsolab 'dab par bya ste/ oṃ oṃ <sku rdo rje'i sa bon/> pradzñā u pā yau <shes rab thabs dag > ka la sha a bhi ṣe kaṃ <bum pa'i dbang bskur ba > me da dā tāṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ <bdag la stsal du gsol/> ces pa'o/ /de nas sngar phul ba'i phyag rgya de nyid sna tshogs yum du byin gyis brlabs nas/ lha mo dga' sbyin gnas sbyin ma/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ /zung cig khyer cig sems dpa' che/ /zung la mchod pa dag tu gyis/ / zhais rig ma gtad/ de'i nu ma la lag pas reg pas/ de las byung ba'i bde ba nyams su myong ba de 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi dga' ba'i dga' ba ste/ de nyid bum pa'i dbang gi don no/ /de ltar na phyag rgya'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ sngags kyi tshul la dge tshul du gyur zhing/ sa brgyad pa mi g.yo bar lung bstan pa thob pas sangs rgyas kyi sras su gyur/ oṃ oṃ badzra satwe na <rdo rje sems dpa' > badzra ka la sha a bhi ṣe ke ṇa <rdo rje bum pa'i mngon par dbang bskur bas > a bhi ṣi kto <mngon par dbang bskur te > badzra satwa <rdau rje sems dpa'i > pu tro a tsa lā bhū mi labdho haṃ/ <sras mi g.yo ba'i sa thob pa nga'o//> zhes nga rgyal bzung bar bya ste bum pa'i dbang ngo*/ /de nas gsang ba'i dbang gi don du maṇḍal 'bul/ oṃ āḥ <gsung rdo rje'i sa bon/> pradzñā u pā yau

<shes rab thabs dag > gu hya a bhi ṣe kaṃ me da dā tāṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa <gsang ba'i mngon par dbang bskur ba bdag la stsal du gsol/> zhes pas gsol ba btab/ oṃ dwā da sha sogs kyis gdong g.yogs bcings par bsam zhing*/ de nas/ bla ma dus kyi 'khor lo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs nas sku la zhugs pa chags pa chen pos zhu bar gyur pa/ a ba dhū tī'i lam nas brgyud de nor bur byon pa'i bdud rtsi mthe bong dang ming med kyis bzung nas lce thog tu bzhag par gyur/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur/ /byang chub sems ni bzang po yis/ /de ltar bu khyod dbang bskur bgyi/ / zhes dang*/ bla med de ni 'di nyid de/ /gnyis su med cing mi 'gyur ba/ /chos kyi dbyings ni dam pa yi/ /dam pa'i bde ba myang bar gyis/ / zhes brjod la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor bsams te/ a ho mahā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod cing*/ dngos su bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba'i nang mchod kyi thig pa lan gnyis su lce la bzhag cing btung bar bya'o/ /de nas gong gi sngags kyis mig dar bsal/ phyag rgya'i bha ga gsal bar byas pa yang bltas te/ de las byung ba'i bde ba nyams su myong ba 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi mchog dga'i dga' ba ste/ de nyid gsang ba'i dbang gi don no/ /de ltar na phyag rgya'i bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ sngags kyi tshul la dge slong du gyur zhing*/ sa dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros su lung bstan pa thob pas sangs rgyas kyi rgyal tshab tu gyur/ oṃ āḥbadzra satwe na <rdo rje sems dpa' > gu hya a bhi ṣi ke ṇa <gsang ba'i mngon par dbang bskur bas > a bhi ṣi kto <mngon par dbang bskur te > badzra satwa <rdo rje sems dpa'i >

yu ba rā dzo na ba bhū mi labdho haṃ/ <rgyal tshabs dgu pa thob pa nga'o//> zhes nga rgyal bzung bar bya ste/ gsang ba'i dbang ngo*/ /de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul/ oṃ hūṃ <thugs rdo rje'i sa bon/> pradzñā u pā yau <shes rab thabs dag > badzra satwa <rdo rje sems dpa' dang > bi shwa mā ta rau <sna tshogs yum dag > pradzñā dzñā na <shes rab ye shes kyi > a bhi ṣe kaṃ me da dā tāṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ <mngon par dbang bskur ba bstsal du gsol/> zhes pas gsol ba btab/ de nas bla mas/ 'dir ni khyod rnams dpang po lags/ /bdag gis 'di la 'di gtad do/ / zhes rdo rje sems dpa' dpang du byas nas/ gzungs ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyis/ /sten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis rtags/ /'khor lo'i rim pa'i sbyor ba yi/ /bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis/ /rdo rje skyil krung gis sems ni/ / nor bu'i nang du gnas lta bas/ / zhes go bar byas te/ phyag rgya sna tshogs yum du byas pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūṃ/ lte bar hoḥ gsang bar swā/ gtsug tor du hā rnams 'khod par gyur/

phyag rgya des kyang chu skyes gur kum la sogs pa'i dri bzang por byas pa ston cing*/ e ma bdag gi padma 'di/ /bde ba thams cad yang dag ldan/ /gang zhig cho gas bsten byed pa/ /de yi mdun na bdag gnas te/ /sangs rgyas bsten pa la sogs pa/ /padmar bya ba ji bzhin gyis/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu gnas/ /bhañdza mo kṣa hoḥ bdag nyid dus kyi 'khor lor gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ sny-ing gar hūṃ/ lte bar hoḥ gsang bar swā/ gtsug tor du hā rnams 'khod par gyur/ shes rab kyi padma āḥlas padma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ ze'u 'bru la hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rjes mtshan pa/ thabs kyi rdo rje hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ dbus su āḥlas byung ba'i padma 'dab brgyad kyis mtshan par gyur/ lag bcangs dang gnyis sbyor gyi sgo nas snyoms par zhugs/ oṃ dzñā na <ye shes kyi > pū dza <dga' bas > a nu rakto <rjes su chags pa'i > swa bhā ba <rang bzhin gyi > ātma ko3haṃ/ <bdag nyid nga'o//> zhes brjod/ de lta bu'i sbyor ba las byung ba'i bde ba nyams su myong bar gyur pa ni/ 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi dga' bral gyi dga' ba dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba ste/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don to/ / de rnams ni dga' ba bzhi'i dbye bas kun rdzob kyi dbang rnam pa bzhi'o/ / de ltar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob pas sngags kyi tshul la gnas brtan tu gyur zhing*/ sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin la gnas par lung bstan pa thob pa rdo rje 'chang gnyis par gyur/ oṃ hūṃ badzra satwe na <rdo rje sems dpa' > pradzñā dzñā ne na <shes rab ye shes kyis > a bhi ṣe ke na <mngon par dbang bskur bas > a bhi ṣi kto <mngon par dbang bskur te > dwi dī yo badzra dha ro haṃ/ <rdo rje 'chang gnyis pa nga > dharma me ghā bhū mi labdho haṃ/

<chos kyi sprin gyi sa thob pa nga'o//> zhes nga rgyal bzung bar bya ste/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*/ /de nas bla mas dam tshig gi nges pa sbyin pa ni/ 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba de ni don dam pa ma yin gyi/ don dam par rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi bde ba ni thig le 'pho ba med pa yin pas/ bde ba chen po'i rten thig le ni khyod kyis bsrung bar bya'o/ / zhes gdams pa ni/ las kyi phyag rgya'i rab sbyor dang*/ /ye shes phyag rgya'i rjes chags la'ang*/ /bde ba chen po byang chub sems/ /brtul zhugs brtan pos bsrung bar bya/ /bha gar ling ga rab bzhag nas/ /byang chub sems ni spro mi bya/ khams gsum po ni ma lus pa'i/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni bsgom par bya/ /srung ba 'di nyid kho na yis/ /skye ba 'di la sangs rgyas nyid/ /tshul khrims tshogs ni yang dag rdzogs/ /bsod nams ye shes yang dag ldan/ /pha rol phyin bcu thob pa yi/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dus gsum 'jug /'di yis rdzogs sangs rgyas kun gyis/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /rang dang gzhan don sgrub pa'i slad/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ khams gsum dbang phyug ye shes ni/ /'di las gzhan pa yod ma yin/ /skyob pa kun gyi sdom pa ni/ /gal te khyod srungs bdag gi bu/ /de tshe sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ / byin rlabs rdzogs byang chub thob 'gyur/ /ci ste chags pas zil mnan bdag /gtso bo'i mdun du blang nas ni/ /sdom pa skyong bar mi byed na/ /de tshe ngu 'bod du 'gror 'gyur/ /dman pa'i sems las skye gnas su/ /gang tshe byang chub sems lhung gyur/ /de tshe phyag rgyar shes nas ni/ /padma'i phyi rol rang lces blangs/ / zhes brjod par bya ste/ sdom pa byin pa'i nges pa'o/ /slar yang maṇḍal phul nas/ bcom ldan 'das bdag la dbang bskur ba'i rab tu byed pa'-i bka' drin gnang bar mdzad du gsol/

zhes pas gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas bla mas/ bu khyod nyon cig kun rdzob ji lta ba bzhin du sems can thams cad kyi thun mong gi bde ba dga' ba bcu drug gi mtshan nyid ni/ 'dod pa bskyod par byed pa 'gro ba rang gi yid la'o gang ba dag ni gang ba nyid du 'gyur/ /gang ba yan lag mchog la ri bong 'dzin pa khu bar byas nas 'bar ba'i thig le bzang po 'dzag /oṭṭas bkug pa mchog gi bde ba rang bzhin gyis ster thig le grol ba bdag ni gsum gyi mthar/ /lta dang reg dang 'grogs las 'dzag pa'i bde ba 'di dag gis ni dga' ba la sogs dbye ba ste/ /'dod pa dga' bar byed de dang po dag kyang mi rnams kyis ni mig gi lta ba rnams kyis so/ /phyi nas gang ba rab tu sbyar ba yis te slar yang mchog gi dga' ba nyid do rang lus la/ /'bar ba nyid la thig le 'dzag pa'i dga' ba yis kyang khyad par dga' ba rdo rje padma la/ /oṭṭa thig le gsum gyi mtha' ru 'gyur ba la gnas lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba rdo rje byed/ / ces pa'i don dga' ba bzhi dang*/ de dag re re la yang lus dang ngag dang sems dang ye shes kyi dbye bas phye ba dga' ba bcu drug tu 'gyur ba ji lta ba bzhin du/ chags bral dang po chags pa che/ kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od/ /rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i gnas/ /sangs rgyas brjod pa'i chos 'dzin pa/ / zhes dang*/ rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med/ /bcu drug phyed phyed thig le 'chang*/ /cha med cha las 'das pa po/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rtse mo 'chang*/ /zhes pa'i don thig le 'pho ba med pa don dam pa'i dga' ba bzhi yang sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi dbye bas phye ba ni de kho na nyid bcu drug yin la/ 'jig rten kun rdzob pa'i shes rab ye shes ni mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes tsam ste/ don dam pa ma yin gyi/ des nye bar mtshon pa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa dbang bzhi pa'i shes rab ye shes ni don gyi ye shes te/

de kho na nyid kyi don yin no/ / zhes 'pho ba med pa'i don dam pa spros pa dang bral zhing*/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes la 'dun par bya ste/ 'jig rten pa'i dbang gsum gyi cho ga'o/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul nas/ oṃ hoḥ <ye shes rdo rje'i sa bon/> pradzñā u pā ya ādma kaṃ <shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid can > badzra satwa mahā mu drā <rdo rje sems dpa' dang phyag rgya chen mo > dzñā na a bhi ṣe kaṃ me pra yatstsha oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥphaṭa/ <ye shes kyi mngon par dbang bskur ba bdag la stsol/> ces pas gsol ba btab/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ / byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag gi gsang chen dbang gis ni/ / khyod kyi sems rgyun dbang bskur ro/ / zhes brjod la/ rkang pa skyil krung*/ lus drang por srangs/ lta stangs g.yo ba med par byas la/ dngos po med la sgom pa med/ /sgom pa sgom pa nyid ma yin/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pa'i/ /sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar dang*/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*/ /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ /rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid/ khyod kyi pha ni khyod nyid do/ / zhes dang*/ de bzhin sems kyi 'od gsal rtog pa yi/ /sgom pa'i thabs rnams bdag gis mi mthong ste/ /de nyid du ni rkyang ma dag dang ni/ /ro ma gcig tu sbyor bas mthong bar 'gyur/ / zhes dang*/ yan lag phyag rgya che sgom pas/ /rnal 'byor chen po kun mkhyen nyid/ /'gyur med bde ba'-i rang bzhin sgrub/ /skye ba 'di la sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces pa'i don chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs spros pa dang bral zhing*/ blo rnam par rtog pa snang ba dang bcas pa thams cad 'khrul ba'i snang ba yin par shes par byas nas/ cir yang rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang nas rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid la mnyam par gzhag par bya'o//

de las yan lag drug gi rim pas thob pa phyag rgya chen po dang mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba zung ngu 'jug pa'i ye shes so sor rang gis rig par 'gyur ba ni gong ma'i gong ma chen po bzhi pa'i ye shes so/ /de ltar don dam pa byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du phyag rgya chen po mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ skye rgu'i bdag po sa bcu gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ oṃ hoḥdharma dhā tu a kṣa ra tsa turthā a bhi ṣe ke ṇa a bhi ṣi kto <chos dbyings 'gyur ba med pa bzhi pa'i mngon par dbang bskur ba mngon par dbang bskur te > badzra satwe na <rdo rje sems dpa'i > ātma nā haṃ <bdag nyid nga > dwi dī yo <gnyis pa > dwā da sha bhū mi labdho <sa bcu gnyis thob pa > badzra satwa <rdo rje sems dpa' > mahā arthaḥ <don chen po > pa ra ma a kṣa raḥ <mchog tu mi 'gyur ba > tāai lo kya bi dza yaḥ <'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba > kā la tsakro bha ga bān <dus kyi 'khor lo bcom ldan 'das > e baṃ ka raḥ <a baṃ yi ge3gt; zhes nga rgyal bzung bar bya'o/ dbang bzhi pa'o/ /de nas/ dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ / byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ sangs rgyas dang ni byang chub sems/ / dpal ldan bla ma khyed spangs nas/ /bla ma gzhan dag rmi lam du'ang*/ /srog dor nas ni bsten mi bya/ /gzhan yang de bzhin dus kun du/ /g.yo sgyu med par nus tshad kyis/ /lus ngag sems dang gsum po ni/ /gtso bo'i spyan sngar dbul bar bgyi/ /ral gri dang ni snag tsha dang*/ /skye bo kun la snyems pa dang*/ /zhing dang khyim gyi las dang ni/ /tshong la sogs pa mi bya'o/ / zhes dam 'cha'/ tshigs bcad phyi ma 'di ma brjod kyang chog go /gtang rag gi maṇḍal dbul par bya'o/ /de nas slob ma gzhug pa'i ched dam/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba ma yin kyang*/ de kho na nyid kyi bstod pa sngon du 'gro bas dkyil 'khor gyi dngos grub mngon par zhu zhing*/

bden pa'i byin rlabs bya ste/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan pa'i phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /mi bskyod rdo rje deng bdag sgrub/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag sgrubs mdzod/ nyes pa med pa rtag pa khyod/ /'dod chags kun gyis rjes chags dang*/ /bcom ldan chags chen dga' ba che/ /de nyid du ni bdag sgrubs mdzod/ /shin tu rnam dag chos kyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ / byang chub sems dpa' bdag sgrubs mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog/dbang chen mchog gi phyag rgya yi/ /rdo rje chen po gsal ba las/ /rdo rje snyems bdag bdag sgrubs mdzod/ /sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa/ /sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /sems can kun gyi yab kyang yin/ /dam tshig mchog gi 'dod pa mchog /bden pa gang gis ye shes mchog /shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bden pa de yis mgon po khyod/ /'dod pa bdag la yongs rdzogs mdzod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag byung*/ / de nyid de bzhin nyid nges byung*/ /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyis sgrib med mthong bar shog / 'di yang rgyud gzhan gyi cho ga yin pas/ 'dir bsdus pa la dga' na ma byas kyang rung ngo*/ /de nas snying rje'i dbang bskur bar bya ste/ thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer dpag tu med pas/ 'gro ba drug na gnas pa'i zhes pa nas/ slar yang de rnams rang rang gi zhing du gshegs par gyur/ zhes brjod/ drug pa ni/ gong du ji skad bshad pa'i bdag 'jug gi cho ga de rnams nyid/

slob ma la bskur bas kyang dbang gi bya ba ma tshang pa med cing mchog tu dag par yang 'gyur la/ 'on kyang mig dar bcings/ gos skon pa'i skabs su/ chas su 'jug pa gsum sbyin pa dang*/ lha ngo bstan pa ni slob ma'i blo yul du nges pa'i phyir/ gsang sngags rnams la sgrub par gyis/ zhes lta bar bskul ba'i rjes su/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin rtsibs bcu pa zlum po'i dbus su zhes pa nas/ mchog tu bkra ba du mas mdzes par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar la 'jig rten gyi khams zhu ba las slar yang 'jig rten gyi khams su gyur pa dang*/ sa bon rnams dor/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo zhes pa nas/ sems can bslu bar mi 'dod ma'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin du lha ngo ston pa las/ sa bon phyag 'tshal las bskyed pa'i tshig rnams dor/ byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun skabs/ dbang rdzas rnams lha'i ngo bor sgom zhing zhal phyag mi bskyed pa dang*/ dbang rdzas kyis dbang bskur zin pa'i 'bras bu la/ phung khams sogs lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du bskyed pa nyid dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes rgya mtsho'i dgongs pa yin zhing*/ de nyid dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi dgongs pa rma med par yang snang*/ lhag par mos pa brtan po can la ni/ zhal phyag gi rnam pa ma bskyed cing dbang gi go mi chod pa ni ma yin no/ /des na khams lnga sogs lhar bskyed pa'i skabs/ mngon rtogs bzhin de dang de'i zhal phyag sogs bskyed na legs so/ /dbang bdun re re la maṇḍal re 'bul ba lugs srol gzhan la yod kyang*/ spros pa lhur blangs pa tsam du snang zhing*/ bsdu na dbang bdun la maṇḍal gcig gis kyang chog la/ sgo bzhi nas maṇḍal re re 'bul ba'i lugs 'di shin tu legs shing*/ dbang bdun gyi dbang re re'i mthar slob ma la mchod pa bcu gnyis tshar re 'bul ba dang*/ rdo rje bzhi dag pa'i dbye bas mchod pa lan bzhi dang*/

rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi'i mtha' kho nar 'bul ba gsum lag len rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum yin kyang*/ re re'i mthar lan re 'bul ba legs te/ dper na cod pan gyi dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ chu dbang gi dus su bskyed pa'i lha rnams yid yul du 'char bar dka' bas/ dbang re re'i mthar mchod pa re re byas na thams cad la ma chad par 'gyur bas so/ /de yang slob ma'i lus la lha bkod nas gnyis su med par bstim/ zhes pa'i rjes su mchod pa 'bul/ gzhan yang dril bu'i dbang gi rjes su yang chu dbang bskur ba dang*/ brtul zhugs kyi thog mar sor gdub rdo rje sbyin pa dang*/ dbang bdun gyi snga phyi thams cad du chu dbang bskur ba sogs ji ltar 'os pa sbyar zhing cho ga kha bskong spros pa can gzhir bzhag pa las khungs thub kyi dbang ltar byas na/ de ltar sems can gyi don gyis shig ces chos bshad kyi rjes gnang grub pa na/ rjes gnang gi 'dogs gzhan dag sbyin par bya ste/ sngags kyi dbang bskur ye shes mchog /dngos grub ster ba bdag la stsol/ / zhes gsol ba btab nas/ rkang pa bcu drug pa dang*/ bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa dang*/ snying po sogs bzlas lung spyi dang mthun pa dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung sbyin la/

slob ma'i mig dag la praṃ/ oṃ badzra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hriḥ thur ldan sman pa'i rgyal po yis/ /ji ltar 'jig rten rab rib bzhin/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis bu khyod kyi/ /mi shes pa yi rab rib bsal/ / zhes mig thur dang*/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu byung*/ /rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin/ /der ni gsal dag rnyog pa med/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag rang nyid ni/ bu khyod kyis ni snying la bzhugs/ /rang bzhin med cing gnas med pa// de ltar chos rnams shes nas khyod/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /skyob pa rnams kyi sras su skye/ / zhes me long rdo rje dang bcas pa dang*/ hoḥlas byung ba'i mda' gzhu/ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ya swa/ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ya mi/ mda' gzhu'i rjes gnang ngo*/ /de ltar sngags kyi rjes gnang dang*/ /mig thur dang*/ me long dang*/ mda' gzhu ste/ bzhi po 'di chos bshad kyi rjes gnang gi rjes su mdzad pa'i phyag len mgrin gcig tu snang ba dang*/ dkyil chog rgya gzhung gi lugs su'ang snang zhing*/ go rim cung zad rjes pa de tsam la skyon du 'gyur ba yang ma mthong ngo*/ /'on kyang gzhan dang bstun na de'i sngon du 'di dag byas na legs par mthong ngo*/ /dam tshig bsgrags pa'i rjes la/ deng 'dir lo chgai mo dang*/ rigs ldan gyi rgyal po chgai mo chos ston pa'i dus dang*/ zla ba chgai mo dang*/ nya chgai mo dang*/ tshes ༵chgai mo dang*/ gza' dang skar ma chgai mo dang*/ sbyor ba ༵chgai mo dang*/ byed pa chgai mo la bdag rdo rje slob dpon 'di zhes bgyi bas/ slob ma khyed rnams la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun bskur ba sogs brjod/ lung bstan gyi rjes kyi bya ba la phyis kyi yi ge gzhan lugs phal cher na/

rdo rje phreng ba nas 'byung ba'i dbugs dbyung la/ gzengs bstod ces brda' sbyar nas byed cing*/ slob ma dkyil 'khor la 'bul ba dang*/ slob dpon du dbugs dbyung bar grags pa de 'dir mi byed par snang ngo*/ /de'i rgyu mtshan rgyud dang 'brel ba 'di'i lugs kyi rdo rje slob dpon du ma gyur bas so snyam par snang ste/ tshig 'di dag rgyud sde gzhan gyi lugs yin pas/ 'di'i rang lugs kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang yin min rtsi mi dgos zhing*/ ci ste rtsi ba yin na/ dbugs dbyung dang*/ chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang sogs kyang mi byed dgos/ 'chi med kyi gnas thob nas slob dpon gyi gnas ma thob pa mi 'thad cing*/ slob dpon ma yin pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba byed par bka'i gnang ba ster bar yang ga la rung*/ des na 'dir phyis byon gzhan rnams kyi rjes su 'brangs nas/ kha skongs rgyas par byed pa'i lugs ltar na/ de gnyis ka bya la/ spyir ni gnyis ka'am/ gang rung gcig ma byas kyang cho ga chad pa'i nyes par mi 'gyur zhing*/ rgyud gzhan la bltos pa'i slob dpon gyi gnas kyang thob pa'i phyir/ byas kyang nyes pa ma mthong ngo*/ /de la dbugs dbyung ba ni/ de nas slob ma'i steng du gdugs bzung la thal mo sbyar te/ dkyil 'khor la bskor ba byas nas shar sgor bzhag ste/ slob dpon gyis/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa'i/ /slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags/ / zhes brjod de/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la gsol ba gdab bo/ / de nas gdugs gzhan du bzhag nas gnas pa la/ da ni khyod nyid dkyil 'khor gyi/ /slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ / lha rnams dag kyang dgongs par 'gyur/ /sems can rnams la brtse don du/ / khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /rab tu 'bad pas bri bar bya/ /sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ / de yi rjes su gzengs stod ni/

mchog tu gsang ba dam pa yi/ / dkyil 'khor mthong zhing bzhugs pa yis/ /sdig pa kun las nges par grol/ / de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba khyod la med/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ /srid pa shin tu mtha' grub phyir/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje can kun gyis/ /de ring tshe ldan dbang bskur te/ khams gsum rgyal srid chen po yi/ /bdag po nyid du khyod nges so/ / 'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig khams gsum na ni gzhan med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral bar/ khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o/ /'dod pa kun la nyer spyod pas/ /gang la'ang 'jigs med rol ba nyid/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bza' bya/ /'di las gzhan yang dam tshig srungs/ /srog chags bsad par mi bya ste/ / bud med rin chen yongs mi spang*/ /slob dpon spang bar mi bya ste/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' bar dka'/ /shes rab thabs kyi bsam pa yis/ /mi bya cung zad yod ma yin/ /ma 'jigs khyod la sdig pa med/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung ji bzhin/ /de ltar yin ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du kyis/ /rang gi dam tshig mi zad bde ster bsten par bgyis/ /'gro ba bde ba myur la rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ / mtshungs pa'i rtag pa nyid du khyed rnams brten par 'gyur/ / zhes brjod/ de nas/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ches/ / zhes sogs dkyil 'khor gyi dag pa dang*/ lha mo sangs rgyas rig ma shing dang bcas shing bum pa dang bcas rgyal ba yi ni dag pa'i sku/ / zhes sogs dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i de kho na nyid kyang brjaud par bya ste/ sgrub thabs bzhin du brjod bar bya'o/ /de tsam gyis byis 'jug gi dbang kha bskong dang bcas rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /dbang gong ma rnams ni bdag 'jug ji lta ba bzhin du phog pas cho ga la/ sku gsung thugs ye shais rdo rje'i byin rlabs 'bebs pa'i man ngag 'khrid kyi sngon 'gro'i dbang gi skabs gong ma rnams mdzad pa de nyid/

phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs sogs kyis skabs 'dir sbyor bar mdzad pa ltar byas na'ang shin tu legs so/ /byis 'jug dang dbang gong ma dkyus gcig la byed pa'i tshe/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi sgrog pa tshar gcig gis chog cing*/ dus so sor byed na/ mchog dbang gi skabs shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig bsgrags zin pa'i rjes su yang tshar gcig bsgrag go /rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi cho ga ni gzhan du bshad par bya'o/ /bdun pa ni/ bdag 'jug gam/ slob ma dbang bskur ba gang yin yang rung ste/ snying rje'i dbang bskur ba zin pa na/ gtor chog bzhin gtor ma rgya cher btang*/ de nas rjes chog ni/ sgrub mchod zhag sbrel sogs la sngar gong du bshad pa de kas chog la/ dkyil 'khor gshegs gsol gyi tshe mchod pa byin rlabs nas/ rjes chog yig brgya bzla ba'i bar dkyus dang 'dra ba las/ de nas/ bsod nams 'di yis 'gro rnams sogs dang*/ kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa'i dbang gi smon lam dang*/ gzhan yang smon lam rgya cher gdab bo/ /rol mo'i sgra dang bcas nas dkyil 'khor la skor ba lan gsum byas te/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su 'dug pas/ yig brgya lan gsum las mi nyung ba brjod/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ /nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa/ /gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir/ /mgon khyod de kun bzod par mdzod/ /gtso bo nus pa ma mchis pas/ /ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*/ /'dir ni bya ba gang nongs pa/ /de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzod rigs/ / zhes bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs pa dang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ / lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūṃ badzra muḥ ye shes sems dpa' dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang gi snying ga'i padmar bsdu ba'am/

bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsdu ba bzhin du rang gi lus la bsdus/ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs/ a shwad tha'i 'dab ma'am/ rdo rje'am/ rang gi lag pas tshangs thig gi lam nas dbye zhing*/ a kā ra ོ'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ muḥ zhes btags pa 'don bzhin du/ skye ba med pa'i don bsams te/ bde chen 'khor lo'i bar dbye bar bya zhing*/ de nas rang gi mgo bor rdul tshon cung zad bzhag nas dbus kyi padma la sogs pa yang ngo*/ /rdul tshon rnams bum par blugakhyogs la bteg nas/ gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ rnga yab dang*/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa mang po dang bcas te spyan drangs nas rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu 'gram du/ rdul tshon dkar pos padma 'dab brgyad bri/ 'o ma'i mchod yon dang*/ dkar gsum gyis sbags pa'i gtor ma dang*/ gzhan yang mchod pa spyi mthun du bshams/ padma'i lte ba la tshom bu gsum dang*/ 'dab ma brgyad la re re bkod/ gtor ma byin rlabs 'bring po dang*/ mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' klu rgyal bcu skor ba'i dkyil 'khor klu'-i tshogs thams cad kyis skor ba spyan drangs te/ gdan la 'khod pa ni/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog sngon po g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje gri gug dgra st+wa/ g.yon pa gsum gyis rdo rje dril bu thod pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa la/ rang dang 'dra ba'i sher phyin ma la 'khyud pa/ 'dab ma brgyad dang steng 'og rnams su/ stobs kyi rgyu dang padma char sprin mdog /nor rgyas dung skyong byi ru'i phung po 'dra/ /mtha' yas rigs ldan kun da'i mdog ltar gsal/ /'jog po padma chen po rab tu ser/ / rgyal dang rnam rgyal ljang sngon 'byung ba la/ /rdo rje gdan bzhug rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/

/bum pa rdo rje padma nor bu'i phyag /'khor tshogs bsam mi khyab dang bcas par gyur/ /oṃ āḥhrī pra ba ra sad kā raṃ arthaṃ añtsa ma naṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ <pādyaṃ/ pro kṣa naṃ/ arghaṃ/> sogs chu bzhi phul/ oṃ a hūṃḥhoḥdza ya bi dza ya sogs klu bcu'i gtor sngags lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ badzra gandhaṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ sogs mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /sa 'og mun pa'i tshogs rnams rab 'joms shing*/ /bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rgyal ba rnam rgyal stobs rgyu padma dang*/ /nor rgyas dung skyong mtha' yas rigs ldan dang*/ /'jog po dang ni padma chen po ste/ /klu rgyal chen po bcu la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /klu chen po khyed rnams la/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i rdul tshon 'di rnams gtad kyi/ rgya mtsho chen po'i bar du khyer la/ /sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ bdag cag la yang dngos grub stsol ba'i sdong grogs dang*/ yul phyogs thams cad du bde ba dam pa 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ oṃ badzra muḥ zhes rdul tshon mchod gtor klu'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa chu bor dor/ bum pa chus bkang nas slar dkyil 'khor khang par 'ongs te/ thig rnams bkru zhing las rjes mi mngon par byas/ sngar phur pa dngos su btab yon na/ dkyil 'khor gshegs gsol gyi rjes thogs sam/ /skabs 'd-ir phur pa dbyung dgos pas/ oṃ badzra kī la ud kī la ya sarba kī la na badzra dha ra ādzñā ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa hoḥ zhes pas phur bu bton la/ oṃ ru ru sphu ru dzwa la tiṣṭha siddhi lo tsa ni sarba artha sā dha ni swāhā/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i 'o mas phur pa bkru/ khung bur yang gtor la sas dgang ngo*/ /de nas shis brjod rgyas par bya ba ni/ bkra shis 'byung gnas dpal ldan bla ma dang*/

/bkra shis rang bzhin dus kyi 'khor lo la/ /bkra shis 'gro la spel phyir phyag 'tshal nas/ /bkra shis rgya mtsho'i sgra dbyangs brjod par bya/ /padma'i lte bar bdud dang drag po'i steng*/ /rol pa'i gdan bzhugs bde ba chen po'i sku/ /stong chen 'od gsal sna tshogs yum dang sbyor/ /bde stong dus kyi 'khor los bkra shis shog /rnam bcu dbang ldan 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /pha rol phyin bcu rnam dag lha mo bcu/ /rdo rje bzhi yis grwa nas rab mdzes pa/ /bde chen 'khor los deng 'dir bkra shis shog /phung po rnam dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs/ khams drug dag pa'i yum dang mnyam par sbyor/ /'chi med grub pa'i bum pas rab brgyan pa/ /rgyal ba'i 'khor los deng 'dir bkra shis shog /dbang po rnam dag byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs/ /yul drug dag pa'i lha mos rab tu 'khyud/ /gdod nas zag med bde ba'i dpal 'byor can/ /sems dpa'i 'khor los deng 'dir bkra shis shog /las dbang rnam dag khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs/ /bya ba rnam dag khro mor mnyam par sbyor/ /mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal/ khro rgyal 'khor los deng 'dir bkra shis shog /lte ba'i rtsa rnams dag pa lha mo'i tshogs/ /tsartsi ka sogs gzhan mchod chos kyi dbyings/ /zung 'jug rol ba'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas/ /gsung gi 'khor los deng 'dir bkra shis shog /las dang bya ba'i 'khor lo rnam dag pa/ /don dam lha chen bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas/ /mthil bzhi gsang gtsug rnam dag shing rta dpung*/ /sku yi 'khor los deng 'dir bkra shis shog /sor mo rnam dag klu dang gtum mo'i tshogs/ /'dod yon dga' bde'i rang bzhin gzugs kyi lha/ /skra dang ba spu rnam dag grub pa dang*/ /'byung po'i 'khor los deng 'dir bkra shis shog /gza' dang drang srong rgyu skar khyim dang cha/ /phyogs skyong zhing skyong pho nya 'phrog ma dang*/ /ghanṭa karṇa dga' byed nag po che/

/bhṛṃ gi ni sogs 'khor gyi'ang bkra shis shog /don dam skyabs gsum thugs gsung sku yi bdag /lhun grub ye shes 'od gsal gzhal yas khang*/ /chos sku'i yon tan 'od kyi dra ba can/ /dkyil 'khor chos dbyings chen po'i bkra shis shog /dkyil 'khor bkra shis dge laigs rgya mtsho'i dbyangs/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa blo gros rgya mtsho'i sgras/ /rnam par bsgrags te skye dgu rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i go 'phang myur thob shog / gzhan yang bkra shis kyis tshigs bcad ji ltar 'os pa brjod par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir/ rgyas pa'i sbyin bsregs dang dpa' bo'i ston mo sogs dga' ston rgya cher bya'o/ /de ltar na cho ga'i rim pa de rnams kyi go don rgyas pa dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes rgya mtsho nyid las shes dgos pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i yi ge de nyid nyan pa dang blta ba shin tu gal che'o/ /de ltar bdag gis dpal ldan sa bcu pa'i/ /gsung dang dgongs 'brel rnam dag bsten pa las/ /drang don nges don ji lta'i tshul shes nas/ /rnam dag dbang 'di gzhan gyis bskul phyir bkod/ /des ni 'gro kun dbang bzhi'i lam zhugs te/ /rnam thar tshad med bsnyen sgrub rnam pa bzhis/ /lus ngag sems dang chags pa'i sgrib sbyangs te/ /zag med sku bzhi'i dpal la spyod par shog

/dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes rgya mtsho'i dgongs don zhes bya ba chos rje kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas sbyar ba ste/ rang lo sum cu so brgyad pa'i dang po shar ba la/ nags rgyal gyi dben gnas dpal jo mo nang gi dam chos gling du'o/ /'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// shri yāstu/ mi 'gyur thig le bzhi yi rang zhal la/ /gnas skabs bzhi yi dri ma 'khrud pa dang*/ /rdo rje rnam bzhi mngon du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /dbang mchog ye shes rgya mtshor 'jug 'di bskrun/ /sbrang rtsis dgra bos ma myangs pa'i/ /bdud rtsi'i 'bab ngogs yongs 'du'i shing*/ /skabs gsum dbang po'i skyed tshal du/ /'phel shing rgyas pa'i don du bsngo/ /lha rigs byang chub sems dpa'i brgyud/ / 7 chos rgyal bsod nams dbang phyug gi /bka' stsal ji bzhin lhur len pa/ /brkos kyi 'du byed mkhas rnams dang*/ /dag byed mkhan dang zhal ta ba/ /kun gyi lhag bsam dag pa yis/ /gung thang rgyal po'i khab chen por/ /phun tshogs gong 'phel ngang nas bsgrubs/ /shubhaṃ/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes rgya mtsho'i dgongs don zhes bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 180--PAGE 179--PAGE 100- EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED
